items.title: Post-Visit Family Snapshot via Zalo
items.description: One tap at checkout sends an approved, template-bound visit summary (tasks done, mood, next visit) to consented family members through the existing Zalo channel — no free-text leakage, full consent gating. Families in Vietnam live on Zalo; competitors offer email portals nobody opens.

items.title: One-click payment nudge to the payer-kin
items.description: Every AR row has a single action that sends a branded ZNS payment link to the client's payer relation (not the patient) — exploiting the kinship model no competitor has. Collections respect family structure.

items.title: Glove mode
items.description: A one-toggle PWA mode: 64px minimum hit targets, doubled spacing, high-contrast mono palette, swipe-only interactions — designed for nitrile gloves and hurried hands, switchable per facility or per shift.

items.title: No-login live ETA link
items.description: One tap sends the family a Zalo link showing live nurse ETA on a map — no account, no password, expires after the visit. Zero-friction transparency for the 70-year-old spouse at home.

items.title: Blockly Per-Client Vital Alert Thresholds
items.description: Per-client and per-condition alert thresholds authored in the existing Blockly rule builder (e.g. 'if systolic > 160 OR SpO2 < 92 for 2 consecutive readings → notify RN + Zalo family'), with plain-language rule explain. No home-care competitor lets clinicians visually program escalation logic without vendor tickets.

items.title: Blockly Payer Rules Engine
items.description: Payer billing rules — eligibility windows, covered services, unit caps, co-pay percentages, prior-authorization requirements — authored visually in the existing Blockly builder with plain-language explain, per payer and per program. Ops staff encode a new government program in an afternoon; every competitor needs vendor configuration projects.

items.title: Live Multi-Standard Readiness Score
items.description: A continuously computed compliance readiness score per standard (VN MOH circulars, NDIS Practice Standards, HIPAA safeguards) built from live evidence — audit completion, credential currency, incident closure times, policy acknowledgements — with drill-down to every failing control. Accreditation prep becomes a dashboard glance, not a 3-month scramble.

items.title: Margin-per-visit engine
items.description: True unit economics per visit: revenue (Blockly-priced) minus staff time from timecards, travel cost from PWA GPS distances, and consumables — surfaced live so managers see which services, clients and provinces actually make money.

items.title: Plain-language filters compiled to domains
items.description: A single search box on every list accepts 'unpaid invoices in District 7 overdue 30+ days' and compiles it to an Odoo domain, showing the interpreted filter as removable chips. Saved NL filters become one-click views.
items.builds_on: biz_bi LLM layer + OWL search panel

items.title: Ops center that follows the clock
items.description: The Operations Command Center reshapes by time of day: 06:00-10:00 leads with dispatch and no-show risk, midday with in-progress exceptions, 16:00+ with tomorrow's unassigned work. Same shell, zero navigation — the right screen is just there.
items.builds_on: OWL ops center shell + health_fieldservice stages

items.title: 'Nearby now' urgent-fill
items.description: An urgent unfilled booking shows a live ring of free, qualified nurses within 3km, each with one-tap 'offer via push' — first to accept in the PWA wins it. Emergency coverage in under a minute.
items.builds_on: PWA web push (VAPID) + GPS + staff skills

items.title: Auto-triaged Zalo inbox
items.description: Incoming Zalo messages classify on arrival (reschedule request / complaint / new enquiry / payment question) with a one-click apply action per class — 'accept reschedule' actually moves the booking. The chat hub graduates from viewer to worker.

items.title: Care Window: Uber-for-care arrival view
items.description: The family portal's home is today's visit as a warm card: nurse photo, first name, live ETA on a mini-map, and 'Thảo is on her way'. The single screen that converts anxious families into confident promoters.
items.builds_on: PWA GPS + portal stub + web push

items.title: Visit stories, not visit logs
items.description: After each visit, families receive a gently-worded story card in Vietnamese — what was done, how mum was, one opt-in photo — auto-drafted from the clinical note with mood-safe language rules and nurse approval. Clinical truth, human tone.

items.title: Care Plan Drift Detector
items.description: Weekly cron compares recent visit notes and vitals against active care plan goals and flags drift: goals with no related interventions documented in 14 days, new problems appearing in notes but absent from the plan, or met goals ready to close. Surfaces as a review queue for clinical leads with one-click plan amendments.

items.title: Continuity-of-Care Scoring in Assignment
items.description: Assignment engine explicitly scores staff familiarity (visits with this client in the last 90 days) and penalizes churn, with a per-client continuity KPI visible to coordinators. Continuity is the #1 satisfaction driver in home care and most competitors only pay it lip service.

items.title: Zero-click visit summary
items.description: At check-out, the visit's structured inputs (vitals taps, photos, service checklist) auto-compose a draft clinical note the nurse merely confirms — writing becomes reviewing. Local-model option (Ollama) keeps clinical text on-prem.
items.builds_on: health.clinical.note + PWA structured inputs + multi-provider AI

items.title: Blockly Care Pathway Builder
items.description: Extend the proven advanced_pricing Blockly engine into clinical workflows: providers drag blocks like 'IF Morse score > 45 THEN add falls-prevention task to next 4 visits AND notify care manager'. Pathways compile to executable rules against care plans, assessments, and FSO tasks, with the same plain-language explain feature. Low-code clinical pathway authoring exists nowhere in home care.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing Blockly rule builder, health.clinical.protocol JSON action steps

items.title: NEWS2 Early-Warning Score Auto-Computed
items.description: Deterioration early-warning score (NEWS2) calculated live from structured vitals at every capture, with color-banded escalation guidance and trend view. Home care rarely has hospital-grade deterioration detection; this makes every nurse visit a screening event.

items.title: Offline Clinical Forms on PWA
items.description: The schema-driven forms engine renders fully offline in the PWA: form definitions cached with the 30-day sync window, completed instances queued in PouchDB, conditional logic and scoring evaluated on-device. Field documentation works in basements, rural provinces and elevators.
items.builds_on: FA-018 forms engine, health_pwa PouchDB 30-day sync

items.title: Vietnam Social Insurance (BHXH/BHYT) Adapter
items.description: Claims and eligibility adapter for Vietnam Social Security: BHYT eligibility checks, XML claim bundle generation per VSS specifications, and remittance import into the reconciliation workflow. No international home-care platform speaks BHXH — this locks in the Vietnamese institutional market.

items.title: Omnichannel reminder cascade
items.description: Visit reminders that try Zalo ZNS first, fall back to SMS if undelivered in N minutes, then a VoIP24h voice call for the unreachable — one policy, three channels, delivery-status driven. Purpose-built for Vietnam's channel reality.

items.title: Late/missed-visit escalation cascade
items.description: If a nurse hasn't checked in N minutes past start, the system auto-notifies the client ('running late'), pings the nurse, then escalates to the coordinator with one-tap reassignment via the assignment engine. Silence is the worst client experience; this deletes it.

items.title: GPS-derived travel reimbursement
items.description: Auto-compute per-visit travel distances from the PWA's existing GPS trail, apply per-km rates via Blockly rules (vehicle type, province), and emit an approval-ready monthly reimbursement batch to payroll. Kills manual km claims and their disputes.

items.title: Ask the roster: coverage questions in plain words
items.description: 'Who can cover Thảo's Friday shift?' returns a ranked candidate list scored by the existing availability matrix, skills and travel distance, each with an 'assign' button. The AI assignment engine gets a conversational front door.

items.title: Risk lens on the client form
items.description: A high Morse fall score or flagged medication interaction auto-promotes a safety panel to the top of the client form with mono-color severity edge — the record itself triages your attention. Zero clicks to see what matters clinically.

items.title: Docked actions become true next-best-actions
items.description: The existing 2-column docked actions rail ranks its NBA column live from record state, SLA timers and the user's action history — 'send payment reminder' surfaces exactly when an invoice crosses 30 days. The rail stops being static chrome and starts thinking.

items.title: Graceful degradation UI for weak signal
items.description: When the PWA detects flaky connectivity it visibly simplifies: photos defer, lists virtualize harder, actions queue with explicit 'will sync' stamps — the UI narrates its own offline plan instead of spinning. Trust-preserving design for rural routes.

items.title: Nurse day-strip with honest travel gaps
items.description: A filmstrip view of a nurse's day where travel time renders as proportional gaps between visit cards — a 45-minute cross-district ride is visibly expensive. Dispatchers finally see the day the nurse actually lives.

items.title: Before/after outcome pairs on the timeline
items.description: Wound-care photo pairs (day 1 vs day 14) render as side-by-side cards pinned to the care journey, with a swipe-to-compare slider. Healing becomes visible — to clinicians and, opt-in, to families.
items.builds_on: PWA clinical photos + care journey river

items.title: Pattern-based smart defaults on new bookings
items.description: A new booking for a repeat client pre-fills service, duration, preferred nurse and usual time from their dominant historical pattern, with a subtle 'from her last 8 visits' tag. Most bookings become confirm-only.

items.title: Missed call becomes a lead by itself
items.description: An unanswered inbound call auto-creates a draft CRM lead from the VoIP CDR with number-matched contact, a callback activity, and the call recording attached. Zero leads leak through the phone.

items.title: Camera-first wound documentation
items.description: From an active visit, the shutter opens in under a second; each photo auto-tags to visit, timestamp and a tap-once body-map location, queueing offline. Wound series build themselves — the timeline comparison view comes free.

items.title: Big-digit vitals pad
items.description: Vitals entry uses a custom full-width numeric pad with live range coloring (green in-range, amber borderline, red critical against that client's baseline) — no OS keyboard, no typos, instant clinical signal.
items.builds_on: PWA visit flow + structured vitals capture

items.title: End-of-visit card stack
items.description: Visit wrap-up is one swipeable stack — confirm services, capture signature, take payment, confirm next visit — each card completable in seconds, order-flexible, offline-safe. Replaces the legacy order-detail flow with choreography.
items.builds_on: PWA payment collection + quote verification flow

items.title: Weekly care digest
items.description: Every Sunday, families receive an auto-composed, human-toned week recap — visits done, vitals trend arrow, next week's schedule — via ZNS with a web view. Retention through rhythm; churn warning when digests go unopened.
items.builds_on: biz_bi datasets + Zalo ZNS + AI drafting

items.title: Auto-Coded Interventions from Narrative
items.description: As notes are written, an NER+LLM pipeline tags performed interventions against health.clinical.protocol steps and the visit's service lines, flagging 'documented but not booked' and 'booked but not documented' mismatches before invoicing. Closes the revenue-leakage loop nobody sees until claim denial.

items.title: Real-Time Interpreted Family Chat
items.description: In the Zalo chat hub, staff and family each write in their own language (vi/en/ko/zh for VN's expat and overseas-family segment); messages are auto-translated inline both ways with original text preserved for audit. Unlocks the huge overseas-Vietnamese sponsor market where the payer lives in Sydney and grandma in Đà Nẵng.

items.title: AI Gateway: Central PHI Guard & Model Router
items.description: Hardens provider_factory into a platform AI gateway: per-feature routing policies (this feature may use Claude, that one Ollama-only), automatic PHI redaction/pseudonymization before any cloud call, per-tenant token budgets, response caching, and a full prompt/response audit log for regulators. Makes every other AI feature deployable in sovereignty-strict markets and is itself a sellable enterprise differentiator.

items.title: Zalo-Native Care Companion Mini-App
items.description: The entire family care journey lives inside Zalo — Vietnam's default app: book visits, receive nurse-arrival ZNS with live ETA, see visit summaries in plain Vietnamese, approve quotes, pay, and chat — no app install, no login friction. Extends the existing health_zalo OAuth/ZNS/webhook stack into a Zalo Mini App. Western competitors cannot follow; they have no Zalo presence at all.
items.builds_on: health_zalo (OAuth, ZNS, chat hub), health_invoicing payment transactions

items.title: Zalo Mini App portal
items.description: Ship the client portal as a Zalo Mini App so Vietnamese families access bookings, ETA and bills without installing anything — Zalo is already on their phone. First home-care platform to live natively inside Zalo's super-app.

items.title: Blockly automation studio (beyond pricing)
items.description: Promote the Blockly editor into a general no-code automation studio: triggers on any domain event, condition blocks over model fields, action blocks (notify, create task, change stage, call webhook) — operations teams automate workflows without developers. The rule-engine asset competitors can't match.

items.title: Natural-language booking composer
items.description: Type or dictate 'Bà Lan cần chăm sóc vết thương thứ 3 và 5, 2 giờ chiều, từ tuần sau' and the LLM drafts the recurring booking series with client match, service, schedule and price preview — human confirms in one glance. Runs on Claude/OpenAI or local Ollama for sovereignty.
items.builds_on: multi-provider AI framework + health.fieldservice.order recurring flags

items.title: Voice-to-structured clinical note
items.description: Nurse speaks the visit summary in Vietnamese; on-device capture + LLM extraction fills vitals, interventions and observations into structured fields, each highlighted for one-tap confirm. Works offline-first: audio queues in PouchDB and transcribes on sync.
items.builds_on: health_pwa offline sync + health.clinical.note + multi-provider AI

items.title: Client Care Journey river
items.description: One horizontally-scrolling, pinch-zoomable river per client merging bookings, VoIP calls, Zalo threads, invoices, payments and clinical notes as typed nodes on a single time axis. The whole relationship at a glance — the anti-chatter.
items.builds_on: chatter data + health_voip24h CDR + health_zalo + web_timeline

items.title: Live dispatch map with drag-to-assign
items.description: A real-time map where nurses appear as moving initial-avatars (from PWA GPS pings) and unassigned bookings as pins — drag a pin onto a nurse to assign, with the validate_drop rules enforcing skills and availability. Uber's dispatcher view, for home care.
items.builds_on: PWA GPS + AI assignment engine + validate_drop API

items.title: Route ribbon preview per nurse
items.description: Select any nurse and their day draws as an ordered ribbon on the map with per-leg ETA and slack minutes; inserting a booking shows the ribbon rewire live before you commit. Route consequences visible pre-decision, not post-complaint.

items.title: Sync-freshness edge tint
items.description: A 2px tint along the PWA's top edge encodes data freshness (fresh / minutes old / stale-offline) — nurses know at a glance whether the schedule they're reading is current, without a status page.

items.title: Predictive Staffing: Roster Gap Autopilot
items.description: Extends the existing AI assignment engine's daily crons from 'assign today' to 'protect next week': simulates the forecast (AI-018) against the roster, predicts uncovered demand and at-risk visits (staff with high no-show/churn scores), and proposes concrete fixes — open shifts, casual call-ins, visit resequencing — as an approve/reject queue.
items.builds_on: AI staff assignment engine + health_roster + AI-018

items.title: Smart Visit-Day Sequencing (Learned Travel)
items.description: Learns real inter-visit travel times from PWA GPS check-in/out pairs (motorbike reality, not Google car estimates) and sequences each nurse's day to cut dead time, respecting client time-window preferences mined from cancellation notes. Fills the route-optimization gap with data no competitor has: actual VN urban travel matrices.
items.builds_on: health_pwa GPS check-in/out + staff schedule timeline (action 1536)

items.title: Zalo Self-Booking Concierge Bot
items.description: Clients and family message the Zalo OA in natural Vietnamese; a tool-calling LLM grounded in the client's package balance, allowed services, and real availability offers 2-3 bookable slots and creates the draft order on confirmation, with human handoff on ambiguity. First conversational self-booking in VN home care; the portal gap becomes a chat strength.

items.title: Instant first-visit offer at qualification
items.description: Intake-to-first-visit spans days of phone tag: qualify, call back, propose, confirm. At lead qualification, the AI engine proposes the three earliest feasible slots and sends them as a ZNS with one-tap accept; acceptance auto-creates the confirmed+assigned FSO — first visit locked in minutes.
items.builds_on: health_crm lead flow + health_ai_assignment_engine + health_zalo ZNS

items.title: Ambient Visit Documentation (Offline Voice AI)
items.description: The nurse taps record; on-device Whisper-class speech models transcribe the visit conversation in Vietnamese, and an LLM (cloud or Ollama for sovereignty) drafts the structured clinical note, vitals, and tasks — fully offline in rural areas, syncing later via the existing 30-day PouchDB pipeline. Nuance DAX does this for US physicians in clinics; nobody does it offline, in Vietnamese, in the home.
items.builds_on: health_pwa offline sync, clinical notes + photos, hr_development_ai multi-provider AI

items.title: AI Care Plan Negotiator for Families
items.description: An LLM agent drafts the care plan in plain Vietnamese at three intensity/price tiers, explains trade-offs ('2 visits/week reaches goal in ~10 weeks; 3/week in ~6'), answers family questions in Zalo chat, and captures e-signature consent — turning a stressful sales conversation into an informed, self-serve decision. Runs on cloud or Ollama.
items.builds_on: hr_development_ai providers, health_zalo chat hub, advanced_pricing quotes

items.title: 60-Second Handoff Film
items.description: When a new nurse takes over a client, the platform auto-generates a swipeable visual handoff: photo timeline, medication changes, 'what this client cares about' (mined from notes), family dynamics from the kinship graph, and voice snippets from the outgoing nurse. Continuity of care becomes an artifact, not tribal knowledge.
items.builds_on: health.client.relation D3 graph, clinical notes + photos, staff assignment history

items.title: Travel-Time Feasibility Guard
items.description: Every assignment is validated against realistic inter-visit travel time (cached OSRM matrix per catchment); infeasible back-to-back bookings are blocked or flagged at booking time, not discovered by the nurse on the road. Integrates into the existing validate_drop API of the unified schedule.

items.title: Open-Shift Broadcast & Claim
items.description: Unfilled visits broadcast to a ranked pool of qualified staff via push and Zalo with claim-in-app; first eligible claimer wins, with configurable priority windows for preferred/continuity staff before opening wide. Cuts coordinator ring-around time to near zero.

items.title: Live Schedule Health Board
items.description: Real-time operations board: late check-ins, at-risk next visits (worker running behind), unfilled shifts today/tomorrow, and no-shows — each tile deep-links to the fix action (call via VoIP, broadcast shift, notify client). The coordinator's mission-control replacing spreadsheet triage.

items.title: EVV-Grade Visit Verification Log
items.description: Tamper-evident visit verification bundling GPS, timestamps, geofence result, task attestations and signatures into an append-only, hash-chained record per visit — meeting US EVV and AU/NDIS evidence standards. Verified units become the only billable units, closing the fraud gap payers care about most.

items.title: Running-Late Detection & Client Notice
items.description: PWA location plus schedule position predicts late arrival at the next visit; coordinator sees the risk and the client/family can get an automatic 'nurse is running ~20 min late' Zalo notice with updated ETA. Converts the #1 complaint call into a proactive message.

items.title: My Day Route View with Live Ordering
items.description: Field worker home screen shows the optimized day as a vertical route: visit cards with travel legs, one-tap navigation hand-off to Google Maps/Grab, and live re-sequencing when the optimizer reshuffles after a cancellation. The nurse never plans their own routing again.

items.title: Budget Burn-Down & Utilization Alerts
items.description: Per-client budget burn-down charts with pace alerts: overspend trajectory (will exhaust 6 weeks early) and underspend risk (funds expiring unused — lost revenue and client value), notifying coordinators and optionally families. Underspend detection alone typically recovers meaningful revenue.

items.title: Pre-Submission Claim Scrubbing
items.description: Every claim runs a scrub pass before submission — missing EVV evidence, expired agreement, budget exceeded, code/modifier mismatches, duplicate detection — with fix-it links per finding. First-pass acceptance rate becomes a tracked KPI; denials are prevented, not managed.

items.title: Capacity & utilisation heatmap
items.description: Province-by-week heatmap of booked hours versus available staff hours from the availability matrix — showing exactly where to hire, where to market, and where the waitlist (FB-029) will clear.

items.title: Competency matrix on health.staff.skill
items.description: Extend health.staff.skill with proficiency levels, evidence links (assessments, supervisor sign-off), validity periods and service-code mappings — so 'can do wound care' becomes 'level 3, verified 2026-03, expires 2027-03, eligible for services X/Y'.

items.title: Invoice-from-visit in one click
items.description: On any completed booking, one click generates the invoice with the advanced_pricing engine's line-by-line reasoning shown inline ('holiday x1.5 applied') before posting. Billing accuracy plus explainability in a single action.

items.title: Swipe verbs on visit cards
items.description: Visit cards accept directional gestures: swipe right = start travel, swipe left = call client, long-press = full action sheet — with icon reveals under the drag so the verb is visible before commit. The Today list becomes an instrument.

items.title: Shift Handover Auto-Brief
items.description: When a nurse opens the next visit in the PWA, the LLM compresses the last 5 visits' notes, incidents, vitals trends, and family messages into a 6-line 'what changed, what to watch' brief with links to sources. Eliminates the 10-minute chart-scroll in a hallway; generated on sync so it works offline.

items.title: Package Burn-Rate & Renewal Predictor
items.description: Monitors visit-countdown velocity on care packages to predict exhaustion date and renewal likelihood, prompting sales with a pre-drafted renewal offer (using the client's actual usage pattern to suggest the right next package size) three weeks before run-out. Turns the existing countdown mechanic into a revenue engine.

items.title: Auto Family Visit Digest
items.description: After each completed visit, the LLM writes a warm 3-sentence family-friendly summary (what was done, how mom was, next visit) from the clinical note — stripped of jargon and internal remarks — delivered via Zalo ZNS after nurse approval-on-sign. Families feel present; nurses write nothing extra. Local-model capable.

items.title: Inbound call/Zalo auto-creates the lead
items.description: Reception answers a VoIP24h call or Zalo chat, then re-types the caller into a new lead. Auto-create the lead from the CDR/webhook with channel, phone, and timestamp prefilled, linked to the recording/chat; agent only adds the reason code.
items.builds_on: health_voip24h CDR + health_zalo webhooks -> health_crm lead intake

items.title: Skip quote verification when nothing changed
items.description: Every completion forces the nurse through quote verification even when the quote is exactly what was booked. If sale order lines are untouched since confirmation, auto-verify silently and only surface the quote screen when a line was added/changed on-site — exception-only verification.
items.builds_on: health_pwa quote verification flow (api_fso_get_quote/save) + FSO sale_order_id

items.title: Auto package consumption at completion
items.description: Package visits are decremented via manual consumption records (health.prepaid.service, action_consume_service_legacy). On FSO completion, auto-create the consumption record when the client holds an active covering package, and skip invoicing for covered lines — humans only see exhaustion or ambiguity.

items.title: Package renewal auto-prompt at 2 visits left
items.description: Office staff currently watch the visit-countdown widget to know when to sell a renewal. When remaining_services hits a threshold, auto-send the payer a ZNS with a renewal quote link and open a CRM activity only if there is no response in 48h.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing package visit countdown + health_zalo ZNS

items.title: Assignment offer timeout cascade
items.description: Staff accept/decline offers via /assignments/respond, but a non-response means a dispatcher chases by phone. Add a timeout: no response in X minutes auto-declines and offers the next-ranked candidate from the AI engine, cascading until accepted; dispatcher sees only fully-exhausted offers.

items.title: Completion reason codes drive follow-ups
items.description: The PWA already creates one follow-up activity type (_create_follow_up_activity); office staff schedule the rest by hand. Map every completion/cancellation reason code to an auto-scheduled CRM activity (callback in 2 days, re-book in 1 week, escalate to doctor) so no visit outcome dies without a next step.

items.title: Next-visit prefilled at completion
items.description: /schedule_next_visit asks the nurse to build the next booking from scratch at the bedside. Prefill it: same weekday/time/staff one interval ahead, package-aware; the nurse confirms with one tap or taps no_future_visit — the office callback to schedule disappears.

items.title: No-show detection and auto-triage
items.description: A missed visit is discovered only when someone notices no check-in. If no PWA check-in occurs within 30 minutes of the window, auto-ping the nurse; no response escalates to the dispatcher with the cancellation wizard pre-opened and reason prefilled — exceptions find the human, not vice versa.

items.title: VietQR auto-generated at payment step
items.description: Transfer payments make nurses read out account numbers and later hand-match references. Render a VietQR code with exact amount and a structured reference at the PWA payment step; the ref auto-reconciles the incoming transfer to the invoice with no typing on either side.

items.title: Voice-First Elder Check-In Bot
items.description: Between visits, an AI voice agent calls elderly clients via the existing VoIP24h trunk (or Zalo voice) in natural Vietnamese: 'Chào bác, hôm nay bác ngủ có ngon không?' Responses are transcribed, scored for wellbeing signals, and escalated to the care manager when answers drift. Elders need zero technology — the phone rings, they talk.

items.title: Clinical Forms Engine (Schema-Driven, Versioned)
items.description: A JSON-schema clinical forms designer — field types, conditional visibility, scoring, mandatory rules — rendered natively on web and PWA, with version pinning so completed forms always re-render exactly as signed. Extends the VU form engine into regulated clinical documentation.

items.title: Smart Conflict Resolution Assistant
items.description: When a double-booking, leave clash or credential expiry hits the schedule, the system presents ranked resolution options (move visit, swap staff, split shift) each scored for travel, continuity and cost — apply with one click. Resolution reasons are logged for pattern analysis.
items.builds_on: Unified Staff Schedule, AI assignment engine

items.title: Hospital discharge fast-track intake
items.description: A 15-minute intake mode for discharge referrals: pre-filled from partner submission, essential-fields-only assessment, same-day staff match via the AI assignment engine, and equipment checklist. Discharge speed is how home-care contracts are won.

items.title: Post-visit family update composer
items.description: On visit completion, a template merges structured note fields into a warm plain-language update ('Bà An walked 20 minutes today, blood pressure stable') sent via the family's preferred channel after nurse one-tap approval. Optional LLM polish via the existing multi-provider AI framework, local-model capable.
items.builds_on: health_pwa clinical notes + hr_development_ai provider factory

items.title: Care Palette: Cmd+K across every center
items.description: One fuzzy-search palette overlaid on all OWL workspace shells (Ops, CRM, Finance) that finds clients, bookings, staff, invoices and actions in <50ms from a preloaded IndexedDB index. Linear-grade: arrow keys, enter, done — coordinators never touch the menu tree again.

items.title: Verb-first palette commands on the open record
items.description: With a booking open, typing 'assign', 'reschedule', 'invoice' or 'cancel' in the palette executes against the current record with inline argument prompts. Cuts 4-6 clicks per operation to a single keystroke chain.

items.title: Booking form that morphs by service type
items.description: Selecting 'injection' vs 'consultation' vs 'wound care' live-reshapes the VU form engine sections — equipment, clinical protocol, consent — so no field on screen is ever irrelevant. Container-query responsive, no page reload.
items.builds_on: VU form engine + health.clinical.protocol JSON steps

items.title: Multi-staff choreography lanes
items.description: Bookings requiring two staff render as vertically-linked blocks across both staff lanes on web_timeline; dragging one drags both, conflicts shade in real time. Directly enables the deferred multi-staff reschedule-drag work.

items.title: Geofence arrival with confidence ring
items.description: The PWA auto-checks-in when the nurse enters a client geofence, showing a shrinking confidence ring on a mini-map; one tap confirms, filling a confirmed audit-grade GPS record. Removes the most repeated tap in a nurse's day.

items.title: Alt-drag to stamp a recurring series
items.description: Hold alt and drag a booking across days on the timeline to stamp copies, then release to configure the series (weekly, until date) in one popover — directly attacking the confirmed recurring-generation gap with a gesture.

items.title: Swap gesture between assignments
items.description: Drag one staff assignment onto another to propose a swap; both changes preview side-by-side with conflict checks, then commit atomically and notify both nurses via push. The missing shift-swap workflow, expressed as a single gesture.

items.title: 'Run my morning' button
items.description: One tap executes the coordinator's saved opening ritual: applies dispatch filters, checks overnight cancellations, surfaces unconfirmed staff, and queues reminder ZNS — with a checklist animation as each step lands. The whole first hour, one click.
items.builds_on: ops center + health_zalo ZNS + saved filters

items.title: One-thumb reachability layout
items.description: Every primary PWA action lives in the bottom 40% of the screen with a swipe-up action tray; nothing critical above thumb reach on a 6.5-inch phone held one-handed on a motorbike-parked street. Audited per screen with a reachability overlay in dev mode.

items.title: Hands-busy voice memos
items.description: A giant hold-to-record button captures voice memos mid-care that queue in PouchDB and transcribe into draft note fields on sync — documentation compatible with two hands on a patient.

items.title: Consent as conversation
items.description: Consent flows render as a progressive card dialogue — one plain-language question per card, tap-to-agree with visible plain summaries — producing a structured consent record without a single form-shaped screen. Fills the consent gap with grace.

items.title: Natural-Language Booking Assistant
items.description: Coordinator types or says 'đặt cô Lan 2 buổi tắm cho bà Hoa tuần sau, chiều' and the LLM parses client, service, staff, recurrence, and time window into a draft health.fieldservice.order using function-calling against the real availability matrix — never hallucinating slots, always confirming before create. Works in chat-hub, backend omnibar, and Zalo OA.

items.title: Burnout Radar from Roster Patterns
items.description: Weekly model scores every caregiver on burnout risk using roster intensity (consecutive days, night ratio, OT from timecards), travel load, client-difficulty mix, swap requests, and late check-ins — surfacing a manager heat-list with suggested relief actions the roster board can apply in one click. Statistics + small model on-box; no PHI, no cloud needed.

items.title: Caregiver Churn Prediction with Reason Codes
items.description: Survival model predicts 60-day resignation probability per staff member from tenure, pay-run patterns, assignment churn, declined shifts, and app engagement decay, with SHAP-style reason codes ('OT doubled, familiar clients reassigned') so retention conversations are specific. Ties into hr_development_ai coaching to auto-suggest an intervention plan.

items.title: Smart Shift-Swap Matchmaker
items.description: When the shift-swap workflow ships, an AI layer ranks eligible swap partners by skills, client familiarity, travel feasibility (learned matrices from AI-022), OT/compliance limits, and historical acceptance likelihood — pinging the top 3 via push/Zalo sequentially until accepted. Swaps resolve in minutes without a coordinator touching them.
items.builds_on: new shift-swap workflow + AI staff assignment engine + health_zalo

items.title: Satisfaction & Churn Prediction per Client
items.description: Model fuses complaint/praise sentiment from Zalo chat-hub messages, cancellation patterns, caregiver-substitution frequency, and payment lag into a per-client satisfaction index and churn probability, with a save-play suggestion (schedule a supervisor call, restore preferred caregiver). Sentiment scoring runs on a local vi/en model.
items.builds_on: health_zalo chat hub + health.fieldservice.order history + health_crm

items.title: Conversational Analytics over the Semantic Layer
items.description: Managers ask ops questions in the chat omnibar ('doanh thu gói chăm sóc theo tỉnh, quý này so quý trước?') and the LLM compiles them into semantic-layer queries against biz_bi datasets — extending the existing metadata-only chart generation into full Q&A with drill-down chips, never touching raw rows. Works with Ollama for on-prem deployments.
items.builds_on: biz_bi semantic layer + pluggable LLM chart generation

items.title: Visit Verification Anomaly Engine
items.description: Unsupervised model (isolation forest) flags improbable visits: GPS check-in far from client address, sub-10-minute 'completed' visits with full task lists, identical note text across clients (embedding similarity), or check-in/out pairs violating learned travel physics. Flags route to a supervisor review queue with evidence panels — EVV-grade integrity before regulators demand it.

items.title: Document OCR Intake (Prescriptions & Referrals)
items.description: Photograph any paper prescription, hospital discharge summary, or referral letter (Vietnamese handwriting included) and a VLM extracts medications, diagnoses, and orders into structured records for human confirmation — killing the biggest data-entry chore at intake. Self-hostable VLM (Qwen2.5-VL via Ollama) for sovereignty.

items.title: Sick-day bulk reassignment
items.description: When a nurse calls in sick, a dispatcher today reschedules each FSO one by one. One action — pick staff + date — feeds all their bookings through the AI assignment engine in bulk, auto-reassigns the coverable ones, and returns only the uncoverable slots for human triage.

items.title: Protocols auto-attach as tap checklists
items.description: health.clinical.protocol holds JSON action steps but nurses still free-text what they did. Auto-attach the matching protocol to each FSO by service type and render it as a tap-through checklist in the PWA; checked steps compose the clinical note automatically.
items.builds_on: health.clinical.protocol JSON steps + health_pwa visit screen

items.title: Overnight pre-visit briefs in the PWA
items.description: Before a visit nurses open the patient, last notes, fall risk, and quote across four screens. During the nightly offline sync, auto-compose a per-visit brief card (last note delta, Morse fall score, medication flags, outstanding balance) so tomorrow's context is one glance, even offline.

items.title: Family Care Circle with Care Moments
items.description: A shared family space keyed off the existing kinship graph (health.client.relation): each caregiver/payer/guardian gets role-appropriate visibility, a task board ('Daughter brings medications Tuesday'), and a 'care moments' feed of nurse-shared photos and milestones. Turns the family from an anxious bystander into a coordinated care team — competitors offer read-only family portals at best.
items.builds_on: health.client.relation kinship roles, D3 relationship network, access_roles

items.title: Caregiver Mastery Paths (Tasteful Gamification)
items.description: A skill-tree progression system for nurses built on health.staff.skill and hr_development_ai coaching: completing verified competencies (wound care level 2, dementia communication) unlocks badge tiers, pay-relevant certifications, and priority access to preferred shifts — mastery and autonomy, not points and confetti. Directly attacks the industry's #1 problem (caregiver churn) with self-determination-theory design.

items.title: Nurse Day Copilot 'Day Strip'
items.description: The PWA opens to an anticipatory strip of the day: next client's two-line 'what changed since your last visit' AI brief, travel buffer warnings, supplies to pack (inferred from scheduled wound/injection tasks), and pre-staged forms — so the nurse never taps around to prepare. Competitor apps show a list of appointments; none anticipate.
items.builds_on: health_pwa, AI assignment engine data, health.clinical.note history

items.title: In-Home Micro-Consult Mesh
items.description: Mid-visit, a nurse requests a 5-minute async or live consult: photos/vitals auto-packaged to an on-call doctor who replies with voice or annotated images, billable as a micro-service through the existing quote/invoice flow. Turns every home visit into a doctor-backed encounter without scheduling a separate consultation.
items.builds_on: health.fieldservice.order, health_invoicing, health_pwa photos, doctor consultation services

items.title: QR onboarding at first visit
items.description: Nurse's PWA shows a one-time QR at the first visit; the family scans it to claim their portal account with relations pre-linked — no emails, no passwords to dictate to a 75-year-old. Activation in under 30 seconds.

items.title: Paste a phone number, get the person
items.description: Paste any phone number into the palette and it resolves to the client or kin via res.partner and VoIP CDR history, offering 'open profile / new booking / log call'. Built for a Zalo-and-phone-first market where the number IS the identity.

items.title: Travel-cost tinting on the assignment picker
items.description: In the existing staff assignment wizard, each candidate row tints by the travel time this assignment would ADD to their day — green under 10 minutes, red over 40. Assignment quality improves with zero new workflow.

items.title: Linked map + timeline dual pane
items.description: Split view where selecting a slot on web_timeline pulses the corresponding map location and vice versa — spatial and temporal planning finally share one brain. The definitive dispatch workstation.

items.title: Vietnamese-First Medical Speech Recognition
items.description: Fine-tuned Vietnamese ASR (PhoWhisper/wav2vec2-vi) with a custom lexicon of VN drug names, procedures, and honorifics so ambient scribe and dictation actually work for Vietnamese nurses — the gap every Western competitor ignores. Ships as a self-hosted inference service (GPU or CPU int8) so no patient audio leaves the country.

items.title: Note Quality Coach (Defensible Documentation)
items.description: Before a nurse signs a note, an LLM scores it against audit/funding criteria (specificity, time anchors, objective language, matches booked service codes) and suggests concrete fixes inline — like Grammarly for care notes. Trained rubric lives in editable prompts per funder (private-pay vs corporate vs NDIS-style); local-model capable.

items.title: Falls Risk Beyond Morse: Continuous Model
items.description: Gradient-boosted model (XGBoost, trained on own data) re-scores fall risk after every visit using Morse baseline plus dynamic signals: gait mentions in notes (NER), new sedating meds from the RxNorm check, missed visits, nocturia mentions, home-hazard photos. Risk changes push a Zalo/web-push alert to the care manager with the top 3 contributing factors shown.

items.title: Deterioration Signals Mined from Note Text
items.description: An embedding classifier scans every synced note for soft deterioration language ('ăn ít hơn', 'confused today', 'refused shower') across vi/en, aggregating weak signals over a 14-day window into an early-warning score that catches decline before vitals move. Runs nightly on a local embedding model (bge-m3 via Ollama) — no PHI leaves the server.

items.title: Family Q&A Grounded in Care Records
items.description: In the family portal/Zalo, relatives ask 'Mẹ tôi hôm nay thế nào?' and a RAG pipeline retrieves only consented, family-shareable note summaries, visit confirmations, and vitals to answer with citations — strictly refusing anything outside the record. Consent scopes gate retrieval; Ollama deployment keeps records in-country.
items.builds_on: health.client.relation (kinship roles) + new consent model + health_zalo

items.title: Monday Morning Auto-Insights Brief
items.description: A cron runs anomaly scans over gold-layer metrics (revenue, utilization, cancellations, incidents by catchment) and the LLM composes a ranked 'what changed and why it matters' brief with mini-charts, delivered to each manager scoped to their facilities. The BI platform stops waiting to be asked.
items.builds_on: biz_bi medallion gold layer + GridStack dashboards

items.title: Live vi↔en Care Note Translation Layer
items.description: Every clinical note, care plan, and family message stores its source language and renders in the viewer's language via an LLM translation layer tuned on a medical vi/en glossary, with 'view original' one tap away — enabling mixed VN/expat care teams and the Australia expansion without double documentation. Fully Ollama-capable.

items.title: Zero-Data-Entry Visit
items.description: The convergence goal: ambient voice (IF-007), camera verification (IF-028), sensor fusion (IF-009), and GPS auto check-in compose the complete visit record automatically; the nurse's only interaction is a 10-second review-and-confirm swipe. Documentation time per visit drops from ~12 minutes to under 1 — a workforce-economics moat no competitor can match piecemeal.

items.title: Honest Trajectory View for Families
items.description: A compassionate, mono-flat visualization of a parent's decline curve with confidence bands and intervention what-ifs ('with physio 2x/week, mobility plateau extends ~4 months'), rendered from the health twin in the family portal. Families consistently say no provider tells them the truth about trajectory; being the one that does builds unmatched trust and justifies premium packages.
items.builds_on: IF-001 twin, biz_bi ECharts, family portal, theme token engine

items.title: Wearable-Triggered Dynamic Dispatch
items.description: Anomalies from client wearables or home sensors (fall detected, BP spike, no morning movement) auto-draft a triaged FSO, query the AI assignment engine for the nearest qualified available nurse, and offer the family a one-tap 'send nurse now' ZNS with live ETA — care that responds to the body, not the calendar.
items.builds_on: AI assignment engine, health.fieldservice.order, health_zalo ZNS, IF-009 telemonitoring

items.title: Allergy Register & Clinical Alert Banner
items.description: Structured allergy/intolerance records (substance, reaction, severity, verified-by) plus client-level clinical alerts (DNR, infection precautions, swallowing risk) rendered as a persistent banner across web, PWA and print. Allergies gate the medication interaction checker automatically.

items.title: Credential Hard-Stops at Booking Time
items.description: Booking and swap flows enforce credential validity on the visit date (nursing registration, first-aid, visa/work rights): expired or expiring-before-visit credentials block assignment with an override-with-justification path for managers. Closes the gap between HR records and the live schedule.

items.title: Mandatory Task Gate at Checkout
items.description: Checkout is blocked until mandatory care-plan tasks, forms and signatures are complete or explicitly skipped with a reason; skips notify the coordinator in real time. Documentation compliance moves from retrospective chasing to point-of-care enforcement.

items.title: Mobile Incident Quick-Report Wizard
items.description: Three-screen guided incident capture on the PWA — what happened (taxonomy picker), who/when (pre-filled from the visit), evidence (photos, voice note) — filed offline and escalated on sync per the severity matrix. Reporting friction is the main reason incidents go unreported.

items.title: Kinship-aware portal permissions
items.description: Portal access is derived from health.client.relation roles: payers see bills, caregivers see the care journal, guardians approve consents, referrers see referral status only. No competitor models family access this granularly out of the box.

items.title: Post-visit micro-surveys (CSAT/NPS)
items.description: One-tap satisfaction pulse sent via Zalo ZNS after visit completion — emoji-scale + optional comment, under 10 seconds to answer. Scores attach to the visit, the nurse and the service line for quality analytics.

items.title: Describe a pricing rule, get Blockly blocks
items.description: Type 'phụ thu 50% ngày Tết, trừ khách gói năm' and the LLM drafts the Blockly block tree in the visual builder for review — the inverse of the existing plain-language explain. Rule authoring drops from minutes to seconds.

items.title: Weather-aware day board
items.description: The dispatch board ingests the rain forecast per catchment province and badges at-risk home visits two hours ahead, offering one-click 'notify + shift 1h' batches. Monsoon-season ops built into the UI — no competitor does this.

items.title: Lasso-assign on the map
items.description: Draw a freehand shape around a cluster of pins to bulk-assign them to the nearest qualified nurse, with a preview list and conflict count before confirm. Figma's selection model applied to dispatch.

items.title: Sunlight theme via ambient light sensor
items.description: The PWA reads the ambient light sensor and auto-switches to a maximum-contrast pure-mono palette with heavier weights when outdoors at noon — legibility as an adaptive property, not a settings hunt.

items.title: Exception-elastic ops wall
items.description: The TV-mode ops wall reshapes with load: an all-green day shows a calm minimal grid; each exception (unassigned urgent, missed check-in) physically grows to claim screen share until resolved. Layout itself is the alarm.

items.title: AI Pricing Rule Author for Blockly
items.description: Manager describes a pricing policy in plain Vietnamese/English ('weekend nights +30% except package clients in Hanoi') and the LLM generates the Blockly rule XML for the advanced_pricing engine, shows the existing plain-language explain-back for verification, and runs it against last month's bookings as a what-if diff before activation. No competitor pairs LLMs with a visual rule engine like this.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing Blockly engine + rule explain + provider_factory

items.title: Fair-Workload Balancer with Explainability
items.description: Adds a fairness objective to daily optimization: distributes difficult clients, unpaid travel, and undesirable hours equitably across comparable staff, and publishes each nurse a transparent 'why you got this schedule' explanation in the PWA. Perceived fairness is the #1 retention lever in home care; making it visible is the innovation.
items.builds_on: AI staff assignment engine daily crons

items.title: Deterioration Early-Warning Score, Locally Trained
items.description: A predictive model over structured vitals, note sentiment, visit-cancellation patterns, and telemonitoring signals that surfaces a ranked 'clients trending down' worklist each morning — trainable and runnable entirely on-prem via Ollama for markets with data-sovereignty rules. Hospital EWS exist; a home-care-native, sovereignty-safe one does not.
items.builds_on: hr_development_ai provider factory (Ollama path), future structured vitals, biz_bi datasets

items.title: Standardized Assessment Library
items.description: Pluggable assessment catalogue — Barthel ADL, Braden, Waterlow, MMSE/MoCA, PHQ-9, pain scales, Malnutrition MUST — each with scoring logic, interpretation bands and vi/en localization, following the proven health.fall.risk (Morse) pattern. New instruments are data, not code.

items.title: Care-Plan-Driven Visit Task Checklists
items.description: Each visit auto-generates its task checklist from the client's active care plan interventions plus protocol steps, so field staff see exactly what this visit must accomplish. Completion rates roll up to plan adherence metrics per client and per nurse.

items.title: Geofenced Auto Check-In/Out
items.description: PWA geofences each client address: arriving inside the radius prompts one-tap (or fully automatic) check-in, leaving prompts check-out with duration confirmation; out-of-fence check-ins require a reason code. Builds directly on existing GPS capture to make visit times trustworthy by default.

items.title: Funding Program Budget Envelopes
items.description: Government/corporate program budgets modeled as envelopes (program → client allocation → service category) with real-time burn tracking as visits complete, commitment accounting for future booked visits, and period rollover rules. The financial backbone for VN government pilots, SG subsidies and AU packages alike.

items.title: EVV-to-Payroll-to-Billing Reconciliation
items.description: Three-way reconciliation: verified visit units vs paid timesheet hours vs billed units, with exception queues for every mismatch (paid-not-billed leakage, billed-not-verified risk). Revenue leakage and compliance exposure surface on one screen instead of quarter-end surprises.

items.title: FHIR R4 Facade API
items.description: Read/write FHIR R4 endpoints mapping existing models — res.partner→Patient, fieldservice order→Encounter/ServiceRequest, clinical notes→DocumentReference, vitals→Observation, care plans→CarePlan, packages→Coverage — with OAuth2 scopes and capability statement. The single door through which hospitals, insurers and national platforms integrate.

items.title: Care journal for families
items.description: A chronological, family-friendly feed of each visit: who came, what was done, curated photos and a plain-language summary drawn from the PWA clinical note. Coordinators approve entries before publish to control clinical exposure.

items.title: Partner referral portal
items.description: Discharge planners submit a referral in a 60-second form (client, needs, urgency, documents) and track its status — replacing faxes and Zalo messages that get lost. Each submission lands in the intake pipeline with the partner attributed.

items.title: Outcome measures tracking & trends
items.description: Structured outcome instruments (Barthel ADL, mobility, pain scales) captured at intervals and trended per client in biz_bi — proving care effectiveness to families and funders instead of asserting it. Pairs with the clinical assessment work and extends Morse-falls precedent.

items.title: Open-shift bidding board
items.description: Unfilled and short-notice visits publish to a PWA board where eligible casual staff bid or instant-claim (with optional Blockly-ruled surge incentives), filling gaps in minutes instead of coordinator ring-arounds.

items.title: Workforce capacity forecasting
items.description: Project staff-hours supply (rosters, leave, attrition trend) against demand (bookings, recurring series, waitlist, seasonality like TET) 8–12 weeks out per province, turning hiring from reactive panic into planned lead-time.

items.title: Unassigned tray docked to the roster board
items.description: A persistent tray of unassigned bookings docks beside the roster planning board; dragging a card onto a staff row assigns it through the existing validate_drop rules with instant accept/deny feedback. The dispatcher's inbox-zero loop.

items.title: One-click day close
items.description: At day end, one action reconciles cash collections against completed visits, flags anomalies (visit done, no payment), posts the summary to Finance and queues tomorrow's confirmations. The nightly hour becomes a minute.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing payment transactions + cash delivery wizard

items.title: Vitals Trend Deterioration Alerts
items.description: Once structured vitals land, per-client baselines (rolling median/MAD) power change-point detection: creeping resting HR, systolic drift, weight loss >2%/week, SpO2 decline each fire a graded alert into a clinical triage inbox with sparkline evidence. Pure statistics on-box — zero cloud dependency — with an LLM only to write the human-readable summary (Ollama-capable).
items.builds_on: new structured vitals model + biz_bi silver layer

items.title: Demand Forecasting per Catchment Province
items.description: Time-series model (Prophet/LightGBM) forecasts visit demand 2-6 weeks out per catchment province and service type, using booking history, package burn-down (visit countdowns), seasonality, and TET/holiday calendar already modeled in advanced_pricing. Renders as a biz_bi dashboard with forecast-vs-capacity gap bars driving hiring and roster decisions.

items.title: AI Intake Triage from Any Channel
items.description: Inbound Zalo/FB/phone-note inquiries are parsed by an LLM into a structured lead: needed services, urgency, location vs catchment coverage, funding type, and a suggested first-assessment slot — landing in health_crm contact-first flow pre-filled. VoIP24h call recordings transcribed (VN ASR) feed the same pipeline.

items.title: Protocol & Policy RAG Assistant
items.description: All agency SOPs, health.clinical.protocol definitions, and country regulations are chunked into a vector store; any staff member asks 'quy trình khi khách hàng ngã?' and gets a stepwise answer citing the exact protocol version, in the PWA or backend. Embeddings + generation run locally via Ollama so policy stays in-house.

items.title: Incident Report Writer & Severity Triage
items.description: When incident management ships, the nurse speaks what happened; the LLM drafts the structured incident report (type, severity, injuries, actions taken, notifications required), auto-classifies reportability per country rules from the RAG policy store, and starts the escalation timer. Incidents get reported in 90 seconds instead of skipped.
items.builds_on: new incident module + AI-001 scribe + AI-055 policy RAG

items.title: Confirm+assign as one step
items.description: The FSO flow is confirm (action_confirm_booking) then a separate assignment pass (action_ai_assign_staff or manual). Run the AI assignment engine automatically at confirm; when its top candidate clears a confidence threshold the FSO jumps draft→assigned in one click, and only low-confidence cases queue for a dispatcher.

items.title: One-tap visit completion sheet
items.description: Completion today walks quote verification, clinical notes, photos, and complete as separate PWA screens. Fold them into one completion sheet where each block is pre-filled or skippable, so a routine visit ends with a single 'Complete' tap and the FSO moves to completed.
items.builds_on: health_pwa api_fso_complete_service + quote save + clinical_notes endpoints

items.title: Auto-invoicing rules per service/payer
items.description: Invoicing is a click today (action_create_final_invoice) or created inline during quote verification. Add a per-service-type/payer rule — invoice at completion, weekly batch, or monthly consolidated — executed by cron so office staff never manually generate routine invoices.

items.title: Drag-to-reschedule replaces the wizard
items.description: Rescheduling means opening action_open_reschedule_wizard, re-picking date/time/staff. Finish the planned timeline drag (action 1536 validate_drop): dragging a booking moves it, updates all multi-staff assignments together, recomputes pricing, and notifies the client — zero forms.

items.title: Zero-touch red invoice on payment
items.description: Buyer tax details are re-asked per invoice. Capture tax code/company name once on res.partner; when a payment is registered for a partner with tax info on file, the red invoice generates and emails itself automatically — no accountant touch for the standard case.

items.title: Monthly consolidated invoice per payer
items.description: Corporate and government-funded clients get per-visit invoices generated one by one. A month-end run groups all completed FSOs by payer (via health.client.relation payer role) into one consolidated invoice with a visit annex — dozens of clicks become zero.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing account_move + health_crm health.client.relation payer links

items.title: Verify-invoice-collect in one PWA sheet
items.description: Quote verification, invoice creation, and payment collection are three separate PWA passages. Merge them: one collection sheet shows the verified total, auto-creates the invoice behind the scenes, and presents cash/card/transfer capture — a paid routine visit is one screen, two taps.

items.title: Recurring series inherits staff, AI only on conflict
items.description: Each generated occurrence in a recurring series goes through assignment as if new. Occurrences inherit the series' assigned staff by default; the AI engine is invoked only when that nurse is unavailable for a given date, and only those conflicts appear in the dispatcher queue.

items.title: Timecards auto-filled from visit GPS
items.description: Nurses key worked hours into pb_hr_workforce timecards that duplicate their PWA check-in/out data. Feed timecards directly from FSO check-in/out timestamps; staff never enter hours, and only days where timecard and visit durations disagree beyond tolerance surface for review.

items.title: Inline availability check while booking
items.description: Schedulers book first and discover conflicts after, triggering the reschedule loop. As date/time/staff are picked in the quick-booking wizard, live-check the availability matrix and existing assignments, showing green/conflict inline with the nearest free alternative — the book-then-fix cycle disappears.
items.builds_on: health.staff.availability matrix + quick booking OWL wizard

items.title: Operations Digital Twin & What-If Simulator
items.description: A simulated replica of the whole operation — demand by catchment-province, staff supply, travel times, package burn-down — that leadership can perturb: 'What if we hire 3 nurses in Binh Duong?' or 'What if TET demand spikes 40%?' Replays real historical FSO data through the AI assignment engine to produce revenue, utilization, and missed-visit forecasts before decisions are made.
items.builds_on: health.fieldservice.order history, AI assignment engine crons, biz_bi datasets, catchment-province model

items.title: Waitlist with Auto-Offer of Freed Slots
items.description: Clients waiting for capacity join a prioritized waitlist per service/catchment; when a cancellation frees a matching slot the top candidates get an automatic Zalo/SMS offer with a booking link and hold timer. Cancelled capacity converts to revenue instead of evaporating.

items.title: Offline eMAR Administration
items.description: Medication rounds work with zero connectivity: today's schedule pre-synced, administrations recorded with device timestamps, and missed-dose alerts fire on reconnection with true administration times preserved. Conflict rules protect against double-administration across devices.

items.title: Nurse-on-the-way live ETA
items.description: When a nurse taps 'travelling' in the PWA, the family sees a live ETA and map pin in the portal, fed by the GPS coordinates the PWA already captures. Kills the 'where is my nurse' call category entirely.

items.title: Contract renewal pipeline
items.description: All expiring care packages and B2B contracts flow into a renewal kanban 60/30/7 days out, with renewal quotes pre-generated at current Blockly pricing and owner accountability — recurring revenue defended systematically.

items.title: Package burn-down as a depleting track
items.description: Each prepaid package renders as a physical track of visit segments that visually deplete with every completed booking — 3 visits left glows amber, 1 glows red with a 'propose renewal' action. The existing visit countdown becomes glanceable and sellable.

items.title: Ghost preview before every drop
items.description: Every drag on schedule or roster shows a ghost placement at the target with conflict warnings (overlap, skill gap, travel crunch) rendered BEFORE release — commit only what you've already seen. Apple-grade direct manipulation honesty.

items.title: Sync icon that breathes
items.description: The PWA sync indicator breathes slowly (2s cycle) while PouchDB replicates, snaps solid on completion, and stamps 'đã đồng bộ 14:02' — sync state becomes ambient truth a nurse trusts without thinking.

items.title: Ambient Visit Scribe in the Nurse PWA
items.description: Nurse taps one mic button at a home visit; on-device/offline audio is captured, then Whisper-class ASR + an LLM (via provider_factory) turns the conversation into a structured health.clinical.note draft with tasks performed, observations, and follow-ups, queued through the existing PouchDB offline sync. Runs fully on-prem with faster-whisper + Ollama (Qwen2.5) for data sovereignty; nurse reviews and signs, never types.

items.title: Care Plan Generator from Assessment
items.description: Completing an intake assessment (new structured forms) triggers an LLM that drafts a full care plan — goals, interventions mapped to health.clinical.protocol templates, visit frequency, and risk mitigations — for RN review and e-sign. Every generated line cites the assessment answer that justified it, making review fast and auditable; Ollama-capable.
items.builds_on: new care plan model + health.clinical.protocol + provider_factory

items.title: Hospitalization Risk Score (30-Day)
items.description: Per-client 30-day hospitalization probability from visit cadence, vitals trends, medication count/changes, incident history, and age/conditions — trained on the platform's own outcomes, starting with a transparent logistic model and graduating to GBM. Shown as a mono-color risk chip on client cards and a triage list dashboard so managers intensify visits before the ER does it for them.
items.builds_on: new structured vitals + health.fieldservice.order history + biz_bi

items.title: Infection Early-Warning from Multi-Signal Fusion
items.description: UTI/respiratory infection likelihood per client from temperature micro-trends, note keywords (odor, confusion, cough), fluid-intake mentions, and family messages via Zalo hub — the classic sepsis precursors home care always spots late. Alert includes a suggested same-day vitals-check booking pre-filled in the booking engine.
items.builds_on: structured vitals + health_zalo chat hub + health.fieldservice.order

items.title: Incident Severity Matrix & Auto-Escalation
items.description: Configurable severity/likelihood matrix that auto-routes incidents: SAC-1 events page the clinical lead via VoIP and Zalo within minutes, reportable events start a regulatory-clock countdown timer. Escalation rules are Blockly-authored per jurisdiction.
items.builds_on: FA-010, advanced_pricing Blockly engine, health_voip24h, health_zalo

items.title: Protocol-to-Visit Step Binding
items.description: Bind health.clinical.protocol JSON steps to bookings so each protocol step becomes a checkable, timestamped visit task with skip-reason capture; protocol adherence is then reportable per nurse and per protocol version. Converts protocols from reference documents into executed workflows.

items.title: Signature Capture on Visit Completion
items.description: Canvas signature capture (client, guardian, or witness with role recorded) at visit checkout, bound to the exact task list and times being signed, stored offline-first and embedded into visit PDFs and invoices. Refusal-to-sign path records reason and photo alternative.

items.title: Country Adapter Framework
items.description: Pluggable national-platform adapters over the FHIR facade: Vietnam LGSP/MOH EMR (Circulars 54/2017, 46/2018), Singapore NEHR submission profiles, Australia My Health Record — each adapter handling local profiles, identifiers and transport. One clinical core, many national front doors; this is the global-expansion architecture itself.

items.title: Care continuity index
items.description: Per-client metric of how often the same nurses attend (families hate carer roulette), tracked as a first-class KPI and fed back into the AI assignment engine's optimization weights.

items.title: Skill-gap heatmap vs demand
items.description: Cross the competency matrix with booked and waitlisted service demand per catchment to show precisely which skills to hire or train for in which province — recruitment driven by data, not gut feel.

items.title: Fatigue & burnout signal dashboard
items.description: Transparent rules over existing data — consecutive workdays, OT hours, travel kilometres from PWA GPS, late-night visits, declined-shift streaks — raising amber/red staff flags with suggested schedule relief. Heuristics-first by design; no opaque scoring of people.

items.title: Overtime & rest-period guardrails
items.description: Blockly-authored labour rules (max weekly hours, min rest between shifts, VN labour-code OT caps) evaluated at assignment time with hard blocks and manager-override audit — compliance moved from payroll clean-up to scheduling prevention.

items.title: SLA-proximity visual pressure
items.description: As bookings approach their response SLA, their rows physically compact upward and their left edge saturates through the theme token ramp — deadline pressure you feel peripherally without reading a single timestamp.
items.builds_on: theme token engine + ops booking list

items.title: Catchment demand heat overlay
items.description: Toggle a heat layer shading each province/ward by open demand vs staffed capacity, driven by the catchment model — expansion and hiring decisions jump off the map. Doubles as the sales map for corporate clients.

items.title: Capacity-aware drop targets
items.description: While dragging a booking, staff rows physically respond: at-capacity rows dim and repel, ideal skill-matched rows lift with a subtle mono glow — the schedule itself steers you to the right answer.

items.title: Org-level complexity dial
items.description: Theme Studio gains a simple/standard/expert preset that switches default densities, visible columns and advanced-action exposure across the whole deployment — a 5-nurse agency and an enterprise see appropriately different software from one codebase.

items.title: Statements that lead with care
items.description: Family billing pages open with the month's care delivered — visits, hours, outcomes — before any amount appears, with the payer-kin as the addressee. Framing that makes paying feel like continuing care, not settling a debt.

items.title: Continuity-of-Care Optimizer
items.description: Adds a learned continuity objective to the assignment engine: it quantifies each client's sensitivity to caregiver changes (from satisfaction signals, cancellations after substitutions) and weights familiar-face matching accordingly, instead of a flat rule. Managers see a continuity score per client and the trade-off the optimizer made when it had to break it.
items.builds_on: AI staff assignment engine + health.staff.assignment history

items.title: Documentation Plagiarism/Cloning Detector
items.description: Embedding-similarity check across a nurse's own historical notes and across staff catches copy-paste charting (identical narratives visit after visit), a top audit red flag; flagged notes prompt the nurse to differentiate before sign-off rather than punishing after. Runs entirely on local embeddings.

items.title: Client Health Digital Twin
items.description: A living computational model of each client built from structured vitals, visit notes, medication events, and telemonitoring streams that continuously re-estimates trajectory (mobility, cognition, wound healing, deterioration risk). Care managers scrub a timeline slider to see past state and projected 90-day futures under different care-plan intensities. No home-care competitor ships a per-client simulation layer; AlayaCare stops at static risk scores.
items.builds_on: health.clinical.note, health.fall.risk, biz_bi medallion layer, hr_development_ai provider factory

items.title: Fair Shift Exchange Market
items.description: Staff trade and pick up shifts in an internal market governed by fairness constraints (skill match, hour caps, continuity rules) enforced automatically — no coordinator approval loop for compliant swaps. A karma system rewards reliable pickup behaviour with earlier access to premium shifts. Gig platforms have markets; home-care rostering tools have email chains.
items.builds_on: pb_hr_workforce shift roster, health.staff.assignment, unified staff schedule timeline

items.title: Cryptographic Trust Receipts
items.description: Every visit emits a tamper-evident receipt — hash-chained GPS check-in/out, timestamps, task confirmations, and photo digests — that families and corporate/government payers can independently verify. Kills the industry's chronic 'did the visit really happen?' dispute and becomes a procurement differentiator for government contracts.
items.builds_on: health_pwa GPS check-in/out, photo capture, payment collection

items.title: Vitals Trending Charts in Client Chart
items.description: Sparkline and full-trend ECharts panels (BP, HR, SpO2, temp, weight, glucose) embedded in the client workspace and PWA, with normal-range bands and visit markers. Reuses the biz_bi ECharts stack so trends ship without a new charting dependency.

items.title: Incident & Adverse Event Management
items.description: End-to-end incident lifecycle: capture (falls, medication error, injury, near-miss) → triage by severity → investigation with contributing-factor taxonomy → CAPA actions with owners and due dates → closure sign-off. Linked to the visit, staff and client involved so patterns surface in BI.

items.title: Consent-Gated Data Access Enforcement
items.description: The consent model (FA-016) becomes enforceable: data-sharing consents gate which records external parties, family portal users and integrations can see, evaluated at the access_roles layer with consent-withdrawal taking effect immediately. Consent stops being paperwork and starts being an access-control primitive.

items.title: NDIS API Integration (PRODA/NDIA)
items.description: Direct NDIA machine-to-machine integration: plan/budget lookups, service booking sync and bulk payment-request submission through PRODA-authenticated APIs, feeding the claims and plan-budget modules. Removes the CSV-portal drudgery that dominates AU provider back offices.

items.title: Enterprise API Gateway
items.description: Versioned OpenAPI-documented public API with per-partner keys, OAuth2 scopes, rate limits, sandbox tenants and full request audit — replacing the PWA-only private REST surface. The prerequisite for an integration ecosystem, enterprise sales and the FHIR facade's security layer.

items.title: Referral partner registry
items.description: First-class model for hospitals, discharge planners, doctors and clinics that send clients — with agreement terms, contact owners and per-partner referral fee rules wired to the existing commission tracking on bookings.

items.title: Intake pipeline with SLA timers
items.description: Kanban from enquiry → assessment → quote → first visit, with stage SLA countdowns, aging colour flags and auto-escalation to managers when a hot referral sits untouched past the threshold. Speed-to-first-contact is the intake win metric.

items.title: Quality KPI pack
items.description: Curated gold-layer KPI set: missed-visit rate, punctuality, care continuity, complaint rate, first-visit lead time, documentation completeness — shipped as ready biz_bi_health dashboards with targets and RAG thresholds per facility.

items.title: Funder & government reporting packs
items.description: Push-button export packs per funding program — service hours delivered, outcomes, incidents, budget utilisation — in the exact formats funders demand (NDIS claim files, VN insurer schedules), generated from gold datasets on a cron.

items.title: Credential & certification expiry registry
items.description: Registry of licences, certifications and background checks per staff member with expiry countdowns, renewal reminders at 90/30/7 days, and hard scheduling blocks: the assignment engine will not place a nurse whose licence lapsed.

items.title: 'Explain this screen' on any dashboard
items.description: A help affordance on every BI dashboard and ops center narrates the current state in plain language: 'Thu is overloaded Friday; 3 bookings in Bình Thạnh are unassigned because…'. Screens explain themselves; training videos die.

items.title: Training-wheels mode that retires itself
items.description: New users see simplified screens with only core actions; after N successful completions per flow the UI progressively unlocks advanced controls, with a subtle 'you unlocked bulk assign' moment. Zero-training onboarding measured, not assumed.

items.title: Arrival pulse on the dispatch map
items.description: The moment a nurse checks in, her map avatar emits exactly one expanding mono-color ring — the ops room reads arrivals peripherally, no toast, no sound, no clutter.

items.title: Goal Progress Narratives for Reviews
items.description: For each care-plan review cycle, the LLM assembles a per-goal progress narrative from timestamped note excerpts and vitals trends, pre-filling the review document a clinician normally spends 45 minutes writing. Exports to the funder-facing report format (private, corporate, government) chosen per client.

items.title: Hands-Free Voice Commands in the PWA
items.description: Wake-free command mode for gloved/hands-busy nurses: 'check in', 'ghi sinh hiệu: huyết áp 130 trên 85', 'chụp ảnh vết thương', 'next visit' — a small intent model maps utterances to PWA actions with visual confirm, working offline via on-device WASM ASR for the core command set.

items.title: Home Hazard Scan from Visit Photos
items.description: A vision model screens routine visit photos for environmental fall hazards — loose rugs, cluttered walkways, poor lighting, missing grab bars — and appends findings to the falls-risk model (AI-011) plus a family-shareable hazard checklist. Passive safety assessment from photos nurses already take.
items.builds_on: health_pwa photo capture + AI-011 falls model

items.title: One-tap lead-to-booking conversion
items.description: Today converting an inquiry means action_convert_to_client, then action_convert_to_booking, then the quick-booking wizard — three dialogs re-keying the same name/phone/province. Merge into a single prefilled sheet: lead fields flow straight into client + FSO creation, one confirm click.

items.title: Booking wizard defaults from last visit
items.description: Every repeat booking re-selects service type, duration, time, and preferred nurse from scratch. Prefill the quick-booking OWL wizard from the client's last completed FSO (same service, same slot pattern, same staff) so a repeat booking is confirm-only.

items.title: Rolling recurring-series generation
items.description: action_create_recurring_from_owl generates occurrences once at creation; when they run out, schedulers re-run the wizard. A cron extends every active series on a rolling horizon (always N weeks of future FSOs), inheriting staff, quote lines, and notes — recurring care becomes set-and-forget.

items.title: Red Invoice nightly batch submission
items.description: action_redinvoice_generate submits one invoice at a time to Viettel SInvoice. A nightly batch job submits every posted invoice flagged red-invoice-required, with automatic retry on transient API errors; accountants only see a small failed-submission queue instead of clicking through dozens.

items.title: Carry-forward clinical note templates
items.description: Nurses re-type largely identical clinical notes each recurring visit. Pre-load the completion sheet with the previous visit's note as an editable draft plus the service-type template; the nurse edits deltas only, cutting note time from minutes to seconds.

items.title: Automated T-24h/T-2h visit reminders
