items.description: Confirmation and reminder calls are manual office work. When an FSO reaches confirmed, schedule ZNS reminders at T-24h and T-2h (client-language templates, staff name and window included); replies flow into the Zalo chat hub, and only 'need to change' responses create tasks.
items.builds_on: FSO confirmed state + health_zalo ZNS templates + chat hub

items.title: Computer-Vision Wound Healing Tracker
items.description: Nurses photograph wounds with a coin-sized calibration marker; on-device CV segments the wound, computes area/tissue-type percentages, and plots the healing curve visit-over-visit, flagging stalled healing automatically. Runs in the PWA offline. Wound photo apps exist standalone (e.g. Tissue Analytics), but none are embedded in a home-care visit workflow with longitudinal alerts.
items.builds_on: health_pwa photo capture, health.clinical.note, wound count fields

items.title: Behavioral Nudge Engine for Care Adherence
items.description: A multi-armed-bandit engine that personalizes nudges to families and clients over ZNS/push: timing, tone (formal vs warm Vietnamese), messenger (nurse's name vs clinic), and framing (loss vs gain) are auto-optimized per recipient for medication adherence, exercise, and appointment keeping. Behavioral-science-driven, self-tuning comms is unknown in this industry.
items.builds_on: health_zalo ZNS, health_pwa web push, biz_bi for outcome measurement

items.title: Outcome-Linked Pricing Blocks
items.description: Value-based-care contracts authored in Blockly: 'IF wound heals within 6 weeks THEN invoice bonus tier; IF fall occurs during package THEN credit 2 visits.' The pricing engine already handles cascading rules and approvals; this adds outcome events as rule inputs, letting VietUc sell guarantees competitors can't even model.

items.title: Care Plan Core Model
items.description: New health.care.plan with goals, interventions, responsible disciplines, review cycles and status lifecycle (draft/active/review-due/closed), linked to clients and auto-attached to every booked visit. Becomes the clinical spine the whole platform hangs off — competitors treat care plans as PDFs; here every visit executes against a live plan.

items.title: eMAR — Electronic Medication Administration
items.description: Full eMAR: medication schedule per client, administration rounds, given/refused/withheld/not-available outcomes with reason codes, co-signature where required, and a real-time missed-dose board for coordinators. Administered offline-first on the PWA and synced.

items.title: Reassessment Scheduling & Due Tracking
items.description: Every assessment type carries a review interval; a due/overdue board and automatic task injection into upcoming visits ensure reassessments actually happen. Overdue reassessments flag on the client banner and in compliance dashboards.

items.title: Daily Route Optimization Engine
items.description: Vehicle-routing (VRP) optimizer that sequences each field worker's day within visit time windows, skills and client preferences, minimizing travel across the catchment-province geography. Runs nightly plus on-demand re-optimize; typically recovers 1-2 visits per worker per day.

items.title: Shift Swap Marketplace
items.description: Workers post shifts they cannot take; eligible colleagues (skill, credential, client-familiarity checked automatically) claim them, and coordinators approve with one tap. Every swap is policy-validated so the roster never silently degrades below compliance.

items.title: Lone-Worker Safety & Duress
items.description: Duress button (with silent mode), welfare-check timers that auto-escalate if a worker doesn't confirm safe after a flagged visit, and live location sharing during active alerts — escalating to coordinators via VoIP call-out and Zalo. Table stakes in AU/UK, absent in most ASEAN platforms.

items.title: Hash-Chained Clinical Audit Trail
items.description: Append-only audit log for all clinical and financial records — who read/wrote what, when, from which device — with periodic hash anchoring making tampering detectable, and a per-client access history view. Foundation for HIPAA-class markets and hospital partnership due diligence.

items.title: Family & Client Portal shell (OWL workspace)
items.description: A themed, mobile-first portal built on the vu.theme token engine where clients and family members log in to see upcoming visits, care team, invoices and documents. Replaces the current portal stub with one adaptive OWL shell that respects health.client.relation roles.

items.title: Self-booking with live availability
items.description: Clients pick a service and see real slots computed from the existing staff availability matrix and assignment engine, then confirm — creating a draft health.fieldservice.order automatically. Cuts coordinator phone tag, the #1 intake bottleneck.

items.title: Package balance widget
items.description: Portal card showing visits remaining, expiry date and burn-down chart for each care package, with one-tap renewal that generates a quote. Turns the existing visit-countdown data into a renewal revenue driver.

items.title: Corporate/B2B care contracts
items.description: Contract entity for employer-sponsored health checks, on-site nursing and executive home care: negotiated rate cards (as Blockly pricing rule sets), member rosters, utilisation caps and consolidated monthly invoicing.

items.title: Unified coordinator inbox
items.description: One queue merging Zalo chats, SMS replies, portal messages and web-form enquiries with client context sidebars, assignment, snooze and SLA badges — coordinators stop tab-hopping across four channels.

items.title: Package profitability & breakage analysis
items.description: Analyse each care-package SKU: realised margin, visit utilisation, expiry breakage and renewal rate — informing package design and Blockly pricing changes with evidence.

items.title: 'Same again next week' on completed visits
items.description: Every completed booking offers a one-tap clone-to-next-week with the same nurse held if available — the cheapest possible on-ramp to recurring care before a series is formalized.

items.title: Denial/Rejection Prediction Before Submission
items.description: As claims management is built, a classifier scores each claim's rejection probability pre-submission using payer, code combinations, documentation completeness (from AI-004 note scores), and historical denial patterns, holding high-risk claims in a fix-first queue. Cuts the resubmission cycle that kills home-care cash flow.
items.builds_on: new claims module + health_invoicing AR dashboard

items.title: Billing Anomaly & Leakage Detector
items.description: Nightly scan across invoices, payment transactions, and Blockly pricing-rule applications detects outliers: duplicate charges, discounts outside rule bounds, cash collections not matching PWA payment records, and unbilled completed visits. Findings post to a finance review queue ranked by amount at risk; pure on-box statistics, no cloud.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing payment transactions + advanced_pricing + PWA payments

items.title: Auto-close completed FSOs nightly
items.description: action_close_fso is a manual click per order, so completed FSOs pile up. A nightly cron closes any completed FSO whose invoice is paid and notes are saved; everything else lands on an exceptions list stating exactly what is missing (unpaid, no notes, disputed).

items.title: Auto-match bank transfers to invoices
items.description: Transfer payments recorded via action_process_owl_payment carry a transfer_ref that someone later reconciles by eye. Auto-match incoming bank references to open invoices by ref+amount and post the payment; only mismatches and partials surface in an exception queue.

items.title: Book-again chip on the client profile
items.description: Booking from a client record still routes through the generic wizard where staff re-pick the client, address, and facility. Add a 'Book again' chip on res.partner and on completed FSOs that clones the last booking with all fields inherited — pick a date, done.

items.title: Client onboarding in one template pass
items.description: Converting a lead to a client leaves payer/caregiver relations, primary facility, and pricing context to be keyed across three separate forms. An onboarding template applies them in one pass: kinship relations from lead intake fields, primary_facility_id from catchment, pricing context from client type.

items.title: PRN Medication Workflow with Follow-up
items.description: PRN administrations require reason, and auto-create a timed effectiveness follow-up task (e.g. reassess pain in 60 min) that blocks visit checkout if skipped. Closes the classic PRN audit gap that fails aged-care accreditation reviews.

items.title: Behaviour Support Plans & ABC Charting
items.description: For disability and dementia care: behaviour support plans with identified triggers and agreed strategies, plus Antecedent-Behaviour-Consequence event charting on mobile that graphs frequency/intensity over time. Directly supports NDIS positive-behaviour-support compliance.

items.title: Capacity Heatmap by Catchment Province
items.description: Interactive heatmap of demand vs available staff-hours per catchment per day-part over the coming 4 weeks, with drill-down to the exact unstaffed bookings. Turns the catchment-province model into a forward-planning instrument rather than just an address attribute.

items.title: Household Multi-Visit Bundling
items.description: Detect and bundle multiple clients at one address or building (couples, aged-care villages) into a single worker stop with stacked visit records, one travel leg and sequential check-ins. Pricing and duration adjust automatically via the Blockly rule engine.

items.title: Barcode/QR Medication & Client Verification
items.description: Camera barcode scanning verifies right-medication (pack barcode vs eMAR order) and right-client (QR on care folder or wristband in facility settings) before administration is recordable. Scan failures require explicit override with reason, all logged.

items.title: NDIS-Style Plan & Category Budgets
items.description: Client plans with category budgets (core, capacity building, capital), plan periods, plan-managed/self-managed/agency-managed splits, and service bookings that reserve budget before delivery. Extends the visit-countdown package model into full plan-based funding for the Australian market.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing packages w/ visit countdown, FA-073

items.title: Prepaid Wallet for Private Clients
items.description: Client/family wallet with top-ups (bank transfer, card, momo/ZaloPay), automatic draw-down per completed visit, low-balance alerts to the payer relative, and refund workflow. Aligns with Vietnamese prepay culture and eliminates small-invoice chasing.
items.builds_on: health_invoicing payment transactions, health.client.relation payer role

items.title: Break-Glass Emergency Access
items.description: Clinicians can escalate past normal record restrictions in an emergency by declaring break-glass with a mandatory justification; access is time-boxed, loudly logged, and auto-queued for privacy-officer review within 24h. Balances safety and privacy the way hospital EHRs do — rare in home care.

items.title: Refer-a-friend from the portal
items.description: Happy families generate a personal referral link/QR; conversions credit them with package visits or discounts via a Blockly-priced incentive rule and feed the CRM as tracked referral leads.

items.title: Client churn early-warning cohorts
items.description: Rules-driven risk cohorts (visit frequency dropping, package near expiry with no renewal, recent complaint, payment delays) surfaced as a retention worklist with recommended next actions — deliberately transparent heuristics rather than opaque ML.

items.title: Visit-vs-timecard reconciliation
items.description: Auto-diff PWA check-in/out times against pb_hr_workforce timecards and flag mismatches (unlogged visits, padded hours, missed check-outs) into an exception queue — payroll accuracy without spreadsheet forensics.

items.title: Fleet observability & sync health
items.description: Operational dashboard for the mobile fleet: per-device PWA sync lag, offline queue depth, failed push deliveries, cron and webhook health — catching 'nurse worked offline for 3 days and nothing synced' before it becomes a clinical-data incident.

items.title: Chained commands with argument pills
items.description: Linear-style command composition: 'reschedule → tomorrow 09:00 → keep nurse → notify via Zalo' builds as visible pills you can backspace through before committing. Complex multi-step ops become one readable sentence.

items.title: Universal ID deep links (#VU-1234)
items.description: Every booking, invoice and client gets a short human ID usable anywhere: type it in the palette, paste it in Zalo chat hub, print it on invoices. One canonical way to jump to any record from any screen.

items.title: AI-drafted Zalo replies with tone presets
items.description: Inside the Zalo chat hub, one tap drafts a reply from conversation context with tone chips (warm / formal / brief) in Vietnamese, editable before send. Coordinators clear the message queue 3x faster without sounding robotic.
items.builds_on: health_zalo chat hub widget + multi-provider AI

items.title: Revenue sparkline woven into client rows
items.description: Every client row in CRM and Finance centers carries a 12-month revenue sparkline and package-burn dot, Stripe-style — commercial health readable at list-scan speed without opening a single record.

items.title: Empty states that teach the one next action
items.description: Every empty list renders the single action that fills it ('No packages yet — sell your first from a quote') plus a toggle to explore with sample data. Onboarding is embedded where confusion actually happens.

items.title: Skeleton choreography, zero spinners
items.description: A platform-wide rule: no spinners. Every loading state is a token-timed staggered skeleton matching the final layout, with the first meaningful row landing under 300ms. Perceived speed is designed, not hoped for.

items.title: SOAP/Structured Note Formatter
items.description: One click converts any free-text clinical note into SOAP or agency-configured sections, extracting vitals mentions, medications, and interventions into typed fields the new structured-vitals model can store. LLM prompt returns strict JSON validated server-side; works with Ollama locally so notes never hit a cloud API.

items.title: Cancellation Probability on Every Booking
items.description: GBM predicts per-visit cancellation/no-show probability from client history, weather-sensitive service types, day-of-week, payer, and lead time; bookings above threshold get an automatic Zalo ZNS confirmation nudge 24h prior and appear amber in the schedule timeline. Recovered slots feed a standby waitlist.

items.title: Collections Copilot for AR
items.description: For each overdue invoice on the AR dashboard, an LLM drafts a tone-calibrated reminder (gentle for bereaved families, firm for corporate payers) in vi/en for Zalo ZNS or email, and a small model recommends best send time and channel from past payment-response data. One-click send with full audit trail.

items.title: Backend Omnibar Copilot (Do-Anything Bar)
items.description: Cmd-K omnibar in the Odoo backend accepts natural language ('show unassigned visits tomorrow in Hải Phòng', 'create credit note for INV/2026/0142') and an LLM with a whitelisted tool registry executes navigation, filters, and safe actions with preview-before-commit. The theme-engine workspace becomes operable at speech speed.

items.title: Wound Photo Measurement & Staging
items.description: Nurse photographs a wound beside a standard sticker marker; a segmentation model (SAM-class, self-hostable) computes length/width/area, tissue-type percentages, and suggests staging, plotting healing trajectory across visits with side-by-side photo timelines. Deviation from expected healing curve alerts the wound lead — objective wound care from a phone camera.
items.builds_on: health_pwa photo capture + wound count fields

items.title: Grounded Clinical Question Answering at Bedside
items.description: Nurse asks a care question in context ('max daily paracetamol for 45kg elderly with CKD?') and the assistant answers only from vetted formularies and the client's medication record via the RxNorm/OpenFDA layer, refusing beyond-source questions and logging every answer for clinical governance review. Retrieval-locked design keeps it safe enough for real practice.

items.title: Exception-only AR dashboard
items.description: The AR dashboard lists every account, healthy or not, forcing staff to scan. Refit it to show only what needs a human: overdue past grace, broken payment promises, failed red-invoice submissions, and unmatched transfers — everything current is hidden by default.

items.title: Auto-composed visit summary at checkout
items.description: Nurses write a summary that mostly restates data the system already has. Auto-compose it from check-in/out timestamps, GPS confirmation, verified quote lines, protocol steps completed, and photo count; the nurse reviews and taps confirm instead of writing.
items.builds_on: health_pwa check-in/out + clinical notes + quote verification data

items.title: Payment promises that chase themselves
items.description: Collectors track promise-to-pay dates in their heads or notes. Record the promise on the invoice (partner_time_to_pay is already installed), auto-send a polite ZNS on the promised date, and escalate to the AR exception list only when the promise breaks — collections becomes exception-driven.

items.title: End-of-day cash handover in one tap
items.description: Nurses collecting cash reconcile with the office via ad-hoc messages and manual counting. The PWA shows the day's cash total from payment transactions; one tap declares handover, the office confirms receipt, and both sides auto-match — only variances ever need discussion.
items.builds_on: health_pwa payment collection + health.payment.transaction + collected_by tracking

items.title: Care Outcome Benchmarking Network
items.description: An opt-in, anonymized exchange where providers running the platform contribute de-identified outcome metrics (falls per 1000 visit-hours, wound healing velocity, readmission proxies) and receive percentile benchmarks against peers of similar size/region. The network effect compounds: every new provider makes the benchmarks — and the platform — more valuable. No home-care vendor operates a cross-provider outcomes network.

items.title: Wound Photo Timeline with Measurement Overlay
items.description: Chronological photo timeline per wound with on-image ruler calibration (place a standard marker card in frame) so length/width are measured consistently, plus side-by-side compare of any two dates. Healing trajectory becomes visually undeniable for families and payers.

items.title: Form-to-Care-Plan Data Mapping
items.description: Form fields can be mapped to care plan goals and vitals, so completing an assessment auto-updates goal progress and observation records — zero double entry. Mapping is declarative per form version, keeping clinical governance in control.

items.title: Goal Outcomes Measurement & Progress Scoring
items.description: Every care plan goal carries a measurable target (assessment score, vital range, frequency of behaviour) and progress is auto-computed from linked observations and forms. Outcome evidence per client and per program is exportable for payers and accreditation.

items.title: Cancellation Backfill Engine
items.description: On cancellation, the engine immediately proposes backfill: pull forward a waitlisted client, offer the freed worker an open shift nearby, or compress the route to end early — coordinator picks from ranked options. Measures recovered hours as a first-class KPI.

items.title: Geographic Corridor Clustering
items.description: Auto-suggest grouping of clients into travel corridors within each catchment (ward/district adjacency) and bias assignment so each worker's day stays inside one corridor. Reduces motorbike travel dramatically in dense Vietnamese cities where straight-line distance lies.

items.title: Vitals Quick-Pad with Bluetooth Devices
items.description: A one-screen vitals entry pad (large numeric steppers, per-client last-value ghosting) plus Web Bluetooth pairing for BP cuffs, SpO2 and glucometers so readings flow in without typing. Captured values land in the structured vitals model with device provenance.

items.title: Auto Mileage & Travel Log
items.description: GPS-derived travel legs between check-out and next check-in auto-generate mileage/travel-time entries for reimbursement and costing, with manual correction and anomaly flags (detour, personal stop). Feeds payroll and true cost-per-visit analytics.

items.title: Sync Conflict Review UI
items.description: When offline edits collide (two workers, or worker + office, touching the same record), the PWA presents a human-readable merge screen — field-by-field, keep-mine/keep-theirs/keep-both — instead of silent last-write-wins. Clinical data never gets silently overwritten.

items.title: Wearables & Home Device Ingestion
items.description: Continuous ingestion from consumer/home-health devices (BP monitors, glucometers, smartwatch HR/steps/sleep via Google Health Connect/Apple Health export) into the structured vitals model with device provenance and sampling-rate downsampling. Between-visit data feeds the same Blockly alert thresholds as nurse-taken vitals.

items.title: Catchment-aware waitlist management
items.description: When no capacity exists, enquiries join a waitlist ranked by urgency and keyed to the catchment-province model; as staff capacity opens in that province, coordinators get matched-candidate prompts. Converts today's lost demand into a pipeline.

items.title: Broadcast center with BI segments
items.description: Compose once, target a segment defined by any biz_bi dataset filter (e.g., 'active elderly clients in Đồng Nai with packages expiring in 30 days'), and send across Zalo/SMS/portal with per-channel previews and throttling.

items.title: Voice reminders for non-smartphone elders
items.description: Automated outbound TTS voice calls through VoIP24h for clients without smartphones: visit reminders and confirmations via keypad press ('press 1 to confirm'). Inclusion for the segment every app-only competitor ignores.

items.title: Data residency & sovereignty controls
items.description: Per-tenant policy layer declaring where data lives and which AI providers are permitted (e.g., VN tenant: local storage + Ollama only; AU tenant: AU region + cloud LLM allowed), enforced by the multi-provider AI factory and storage config.

items.title: Keyboard-first scheduler on web_timeline
items.description: j/k moves between slots, a assigns, r reschedules, x flags conflict — a vim layer over the unified staff schedule (action 1536) with an on-screen key legend that fades after mastery. Power dispatchers schedule a full day without a mouse.

items.title: Nurse action sheet: palette for thumbs
items.description: Long-press the PWA bottom nav to open a searchable action sheet — 'gọi khách' (call client), 'báo trễ' (report late), 'xem đường' (route) — the command palette re-imagined for one-handed touch. Same command registry, different surface.

items.title: Conversational chart refinement in BI explorer
items.description: After the pluggable-LLM generates a chart, follow-ups like 'chỉ quý này, tách theo tỉnh' morph the ECharts config in place with an animated transition between states. Analysis becomes a dialogue, not a rebuild.
items.builds_on: biz_bi ECharts explorer + pluggable LLM chart generation

items.title: Episode swimlanes for care arcs
items.description: Group related bookings into named care episodes (post-surgery recovery, wound series) rendered as swimlanes with milestone flags and expected-vs-actual visit pacing. Turns a flat booking list into a clinical narrative.

items.title: Drag a client onto the calendar
items.description: Drag any client from a CRM list straight onto a calendar slot to launch the booking wizard pre-filled with client, their usual service and preferred nurse. Cross-surface drag turns two screens into one motion.

items.title: Kanban card to timeline slot
items.description: Drag a booking card straight from the stage kanban onto the web_timeline to simultaneously schedule and advance its stage — planning and pipeline stop being separate screens.

items.title: Three-things-first screens
items.description: Every workspace opens showing only its three most consequential elements (today's exceptions, one KPI, one action); 'show more' expands and the density choice persists per user via theme tokens. Calm software that scales to power use.

items.title: First-booking guided stepper that shrinks
items.description: The first five bookings run as a focused full-screen stepper; from the sixth, the same flow renders as the compact expert form — the UI literally graduates with the user, tracked per flow per user.

items.title: Typeform-style progressive VU forms on mobile
items.description: On narrow containers, VU form engine sections reveal one validated step at a time with a progress rail — long clinical forms feel like a conversation on a phone. Same form definition, container-query switched.
items.builds_on: VU form engine + container-query responsive forms

items.title: Milestone moments
items.description: Wound healed, first unassisted walk, package completed — clinical milestones render as warm flat-color celebration cards in the family feed, assembled from protocol outcomes. Care progress made emotionally visible.

items.title: Grandchild mode for elderly payers
items.description: A portal preset with 20px+ type, one item per screen, and tap-to-hear voice playback of updates in Vietnamese — designed for the elderly spouse who is often the actual daily reader.

items.title: Peripheral color-temperature health
items.description: The entire dashboard's neutral tones shift almost imperceptibly warm as SLA health degrades, driven by a computed token — the room senses trouble before anyone reads a number. Only possible because theming is a token engine.

items.title: Price Sensitivity & Quote-Win Model
items.description: Learns quote acceptance probability from historical quotes (service mix, price level, catchment, channel, discounts) and shows sales a win-probability gauge plus the revenue-optimal discount band while quoting. Feeds anonymized elasticity curves back to pricing strategy dashboards in biz_bi.

items.title: AI Skills Inference from Documented Work
items.description: Mines visit notes and completed protocol steps to infer demonstrated competencies (wound care, dementia handling, injection technique) and proposes updates to health.staff.skill with evidence citations, keeping the assignment engine's skill matrix honest without manual HR upkeep. Local embedding model capable.

items.title: Personalized Micro-Training Pusher
items.description: When notes or incidents reveal a skill gap (e.g., repeated transfer-technique struggles), the system pushes a 3-minute targeted micro-lesson to the nurse's PWA before their next similar visit, generated from the agency's own protocol library by the LLM. Extends hr_development_ai from career coaching into just-in-time clinical coaching.

items.title: Why-Did-This-Change Metric Explainer
items.description: Click any KPI movement on a biz_bi dashboard and a decomposition engine attributes the delta across dimensions (catchment, service, payer, staff cohort), with the LLM narrating the top drivers in one paragraph. Turns dashboards from 'what' into 'why' — the feature every Epic/PowerBI shop still lacks at point-of-use.

items.title: Pill Recognition for Medication Verification
items.description: Before administering, the nurse points the camera at dispensed pills; a vision model identifies shape/color/imprint against the client's medication list (RxNorm-coded) and flags mismatches or missing doses on the spot, logging the photo as administration evidence in the future eMAR. Cloud vision or self-hosted model per deployment.

items.title: Cancelled slot auto-backfill
items.description: When action_cancel_booking frees a slot, it simply dies; schedulers rarely refill it. On cancellation, auto-offer the freed staff/time to clients with pending reschedules or waitlisted leads in the same catchment via ZNS; first acceptance books it automatically.
items.builds_on: health_fieldservice action_cancel_booking + health_zalo ZNS + catchment-province model

items.title: Auto-reprice on reschedule across holidays
items.description: Rescheduling a visit onto a TET/holiday date silently keeps the old price until someone re-edits the quote. On any reschedule, re-run the Blockly pricing rules; if the total changes, auto-update the quote and send the client a one-tap price-consent ZNS — no manual quote surgery.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing holiday/TET multipliers + FSO reschedule flow

items.title: Approve from the notification itself
items.description: Pricing and discount approvals force the approver into the backend form. Embed approve/reject actions directly in the push notification and Zalo message with the rule-explain summary inline; the decision writes back through the existing approval workflow without opening Odoo.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing approval workflow + health_zalo chat hub + PWA push

items.title: Collaborative Care Canvas
items.description: A Figma-style real-time multiplayer canvas where nurse, doctor, allied health, care manager, and (view-scoped) family co-edit a client's care picture: goals, interventions, observations, and photos as draggable cards with live cursors and presence. Every card is a structured record underneath, so the canvas IS the care plan, not a drawing of it. Healthcare software has nothing multiplayer today.
items.builds_on: health_theme OWL workspace shell, access_roles field/record-level security

items.title: Smart-Home Sensor Fusion Telemonitoring
items.description: Cheap BLE/LoRa sensors (bed mat, door, motion, smart scale, BP cuff) feed a home gateway that batches into the client's health twin: sleep disruption, bathroom frequency, missed-meal patterns become deterioration signals between visits. Designed rural-first: gateway stores-and-forwards over 2G/SMS when broadband is absent. RPM vendors monitor vitals; nobody fuses ambient home signals into home-care operations.
items.builds_on: new (feeds IF-001 twin), biz_bi silver layer for signal storage

items.title: Burnout & Mood Radar
items.description: Passive wellbeing sensing across the workforce and client base: note-writing sentiment drift, shift-swap frequency spikes, Zalo message tone, and declining photo counts feed a private early-warning radar for care managers — with interventions routed through hr_development_ai coaching. Detects the resignation and the client depression before either is spoken.
items.builds_on: hr_development_ai, health_zalo chat hub, clinical notes

items.title: Catchment Health Heatmap Twin
items.description: An epidemiological operations layer over the catchment-province model: dengue/flu season signals, aging-density projections, and referral-source flows rendered as a live map twin that drives where to open the next facility and which services to market by district. Public-health-grade planning inside an operational platform.
items.builds_on: catchment-province model, biz_bi ECharts explorer, health_crm referral data

items.title: Camera Medication Verification
items.description: Before administering, the nurse points the PWA camera at the medications; on-device vision matches pill appearance and packaging against the client's eMAR and the existing RxNorm/OpenFDA interaction data, blocking wrong-drug/wrong-dose errors at the bedside — offline. Barcode eMAR exists in facilities; visual verification in homes (where nothing is barcoded) exists nowhere.

items.title: Structured Vitals Observations Model
items.description: Replace the free-text vitals field with a typed health.vital.observation model (code, value, unit, method, position, device, taken_by, LOINC-ready coding) captured on web and PWA. Every downstream feature — trending, alerts, FHIR export, wearables — depends on this one schema.

items.title: Wound Care Records & Staging
items.description: Wound registry per client: location on body map, etiology, stage/classification (NPUAP, Wagner), dimensions, exudate, treatment orders and dressing schedule, with each visit recording a structured wound review. Turns the existing wound-count field into real clinical documentation.

items.title: Recurring Series Auto-Generation
items.description: Materialize concrete fieldservice orders from recurrence rules (RRULE-style: weekly patterns, nth-weekday, skip-holiday) on a rolling horizon, replacing today's recurring flags that generate nothing. Includes holiday-calendar awareness and pause/resume for hospital admissions.

items.title: Claims Management Lifecycle
items.description: A claim object per payer episode: prepare (gather verified visits + codes) → validate → submit → track status → post remittance → rework denials, with aging and denial-reason analytics. Payer-agnostic core with pluggable submission adapters per scheme.

items.title: Online bill pay (VNPay/MoMo/ZaloPay)
items.description: Pay invoices and package top-ups in the portal via Vietnamese wallets and cards, reconciled into health_invoicing payment transactions automatically. Extends the PWA's field payment collection to self-service.

items.title: Government & funder contract tracking
items.description: Model funded programs (future NDIS, aged-care packages, insurer schemes) with budget envelopes, allowed service codes, utilisation burn-down and claim-ready line items — the CRM backbone for the Australia expansion.

items.title: Emergency broadcast by catchment
items.description: One-click mass notification to all clients and staff in selected catchment provinces during typhoons or floods — service suspensions, safety guidance, rescheduling info — with delivery confirmation tracking. Uses the catchment model no generic mass-notify tool has.

items.title: Config-as-code environment promotion
items.description: Export theme tokens, Blockly rule sets, BI dashboards, message templates and role matrices as versioned bundles that promote UAT→production with diff preview and rollback — ending hand-replication of config and noupdate-seed pain.

items.title: E-signature infrastructure
items.description: Platform-wide signing service: touch signatures for visit confirmations, OTP-verified signatures for care agreements, and VN Decree 130-compliant digital certificates for contracts — one API consumed by PWA, portal and CRM alike.

items.title: Ask-the-team box with honest SLAs
items.description: Families ask anything in one tap; questions route to the coordinator with a visible 'we answer within 4 working hours' promise and countdown. Bounded, accountable communication instead of unanswered Zalo anxiety.

items.title: Story-mode rotation for open work
items.description: Idle TV mode rotates each unassigned booking as a 10-second 'who / where / why it matters' card with the client's photo and catchment map — open work becomes impossible to ignore because it has a face.

items.title: Multi-Provider Care Ecosystem Exchange
items.description: When a provider can't staff a visit in a catchment, the platform brokers it to vetted partner providers on the network with rate cards, credential verification, and outcome accountability — like a code-share alliance for care. The catchment-province model already knows who covers where; this monetizes overflow instead of losing it.

items.title: Synthetic Twin Training Simulator
items.description: New hires practice in a sandbox PWA against synthetic clients statistically generated from the provider's real caseload (via the twin models) — realistic Vietnamese elder personas, deteriorations, and family dynamics, with AI grading of their documentation and decisions. Onboarding time drops; no real client data is ever exposed.
items.builds_on: health_pwa, hr_development_ai coaching, IF-001 twin models

items.title: Family Automation Blocks
items.description: A radically simplified Blockly palette for families: 'IF Mum's door sensor shows no kitchen activity by 9am THEN send me a Zalo alert AND ask the care line to call her.' Families compose their own peace-of-mind automations from telemonitoring signals and care events — the pricing engine's low-code paradigm extended to the people who pay.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing Blockly engine, health_zalo ZNS, IF-009 sensors

items.title: Care Plan Template Library by Service Line
items.description: Curated plan templates per service line (post-op home nursing, dementia care, disability daily-living, palliative) with pre-wired goals, interventions and review intervals; coordinators instantiate and tailor in minutes. Templates are versioned so plan quality improves centrally across all facilities.

items.title: Client & Staff Preference/Exclusion Constraints
items.description: Structured preference records — client prefers female staff, Vietnamese-speaking, no-smoker; staff excluded from specific households (safety) — enforced as hard or soft constraints in assignment and swap flows. Every exclusion carries a reason and review date for fairness governance.

items.title: Voice Notes Attached to Visits
items.description: On-device audio recording attached to visit records for hands-busy moments (wound dressing, transfers), stored offline and synced with the visit; playback available in the client chart. Recording notice/consent handling is built in per the client's consent profile.

items.title: Versioned Price Lists per Funding Scheme
items.description: Scheme price catalogues (NDIS price guide, VN insurer schedules, corporate rate cards) imported as dated versions with automatic effective-date switching and variance reports when internal rates drift from scheme caps. Annual price-guide updates become an import, not a re-keying project.

items.title: Terminology Service (SNOMED/ICD-10/LOINC)
items.description: Embedded terminology service with SNOMED CT concept search, ICD-10 (including the Vietnamese MOH code set) and LOINC for observations — vi/en synonym search, value-set binding for forms, and mapping tables per payer. Every coded field across clinical, billing and FHIR draws from this one service.

items.title: Telehealth video visits
items.description: Browser-based WebRTC video consults (self-hostable LiveKit/Jitsi for data sovereignty) launched from a booking, with the visit note flowing into the same clinical record as in-person visits. Enables doctor consultations without a separate telehealth vendor.

items.title: Care team directory
items.description: Portal page showing each assigned staff member's photo, role, verified credentials and languages, pulled from the credential registry (FB-071). Builds trust before a stranger enters the home — a proven conversion lever.

items.title: Partner performance scorecards
items.description: Per-partner dashboards: referral volume, conversion rate, average client lifetime value and payment quality — used in quarterly partner reviews and to tier referral fee rules. Built as biz_bi dashboards, not a new reporting stack.

items.title: Feedback & complaint analytics
items.description: Aggregate CSAT/NPS (FB-012) and complaint tracker (FB-018) data into theme, trend and staff-level views with alert thresholds — closing the quality loop from signal to systemic fix.

items.title: Public quality transparency page
items.description: An opt-in public page publishing selected verified stats — on-time rate, satisfaction score, credential coverage — straight from gold datasets. Radical transparency as a trust weapon in a market of unverifiable agency claims.

items.title: Auto-attach inbound leads by phone match
items.description: action_navigate_to_phone_duplicate makes a human spot and chase duplicates. Instead, normalize the phone at lead creation and auto-attach to the existing contact/lead thread; only ambiguous matches (shared family phone) land in a small review queue.

items.title: Check-in is the start button
items.description: Nurses currently check in AND tap Start Service (/api/fso/<id>/start) as separate PWA actions. Collapse them: a successful check-in with GPS auto-transitions the FSO to in_progress; the separate start tap disappears entirely.

items.title: Roster publish auto-notifies staff
items.description: After building the roster board, coordinators separately message each nurse their week. Publishing the roster automatically pushes each staff member a personalized week view to the PWA and a ZNS summary — the communication step is absorbed into the publish click.
items.builds_on: health_roster planning board + health_pwa push + health_zalo

items.title: Bulk close with per-record validation report
items.description: Month-end closing means opening completed FSOs one at a time to click close. Add a list-view bulk action: select all completed+paid orders, one click closes them and returns a compact report of which records were skipped and the exact blocking reason for each.
items.builds_on: health_fieldservice action_close_fso + Odoo list-view server actions

items.title: Facility auto-inferred from catchment province
items.description: The booking wizard makes staff pick a facility from a dropdown even though the client's province maps to one catchment. Auto-select facility (and its timezone) from health.province catchment mapping, with the dropdown shown only for genuinely multi-facility provinces.
items.builds_on: health_crm health.province catchment model + booking wizard

items.title: Shift Handover Summaries
items.description: A structured handover object per client per day: outstanding tasks, new orders, alerts, and changes since last shift, assembled automatically from visit records and acknowledged by the incoming worker. Kills the WhatsApp-group handover culture that loses clinical information.

items.title: Versioned Schedule Publish & Notify
items.description: Rosters publish as versions; affected staff get a per-person change digest (only their deltas) via push and Zalo, and must acknowledge material changes to their next 48 hours. Unacknowledged critical changes escalate to coordinators automatically.
items.builds_on: health_pwa staff notification bell, health_zalo ZNS

items.title: Photo Annotation & Body Map Marking
items.description: Annotate clinical photos on-device (arrows, circles, labels) and mark findings on an anatomical body map that persists per client — pressure areas, bruises, wound sites — with each marker linked to its records over time. Original photos are preserved immutably alongside annotations.

items.title: Split Billing Across Payers
items.description: One visit, multiple payers: government program covers N units, insurer a percentage, family the gap — split rules defined per client via the payer rules engine, generating correctly separated invoices and claims from a single delivery record. Removes the manual re-invoicing that plagues mixed-funding clients.

items.title: Lab Orders & Results Ingestion
items.description: Order home-collected pathology and ingest results as FHIR DiagnosticReport/Observation (or HL7v2 via a converter), with abnormal-flag routing to the responsible nurse and results trending alongside vitals in the client chart. Adapters target major VN lab chains (Medlatec, Diag) first.

items.title: e-Prescription System Hooks (VN National)
items.description: Adapter to Vietnam's national e-prescription system: pull prescriptions by client national ID into the medication list, reconcile against eMAR orders, and flag discrepancies for nurse review. Keeps home-administered medication synchronized with what doctors actually prescribed.

items.title: Event Webhooks & FHIR Subscriptions
items.description: Partner-facing webhook subscriptions on business events (visit completed, incident raised, care plan updated) with signed payloads, retries and dead-letter queues, plus FHIR R4 Subscription support on the facade. Hospitals and insurers get pushed updates instead of polling.

items.title: Weekly family digest
items.description: Auto-compiled weekly summary (visits done, upcoming schedule, package balance, care notes highlights) delivered by Zalo or email per family preference. Keeps distant adult children — the actual buyers — engaged and reassured.

items.title: Complaint-to-resolution tracker
items.description: Clients raise concerns in the portal and watch a visible status lane (received → investigating → resolved) with SLA timestamps. Transparency defuses escalation and produces structured complaint data for quality KPIs.

items.title: Marketing journey automation
items.description: Visual drip sequences across Zalo ZNS, email and SMS: enquiry nurture, post-assessment follow-up, dormant-client win-back — with entry/exit conditions built in the Blockly rule editor rather than a bolt-on marketing tool.

items.title: Two-way reply handling on reminders
items.description: Replies to reminders are parsed for confirm/cancel/reschedule intents (keyword rules per channel); confirmations mark the booking, cancellations trigger the cancellation workflow, and ambiguity routes to the coordinator inbox.

items.title: Critical-message read receipts & escalation
items.description: Messages flagged critical (schedule change today, medication instruction) demand acknowledgement; unacknowledged ones escalate channel-by-channel and finally to a human call task. Guarantees the message got through, not just delivered.

items.title: Executive daily digest with auto-narrative
items.description: A 07:00 digest (yesterday's visits, exceptions, revenue, staffing gaps) with a short generated narrative using the existing pluggable-LLM chart generation — runnable on Ollama locally so no operational data leaves the server.

items.title: Retention risk worklist
items.description: Combine tenure, fatigue flags (FB-079), pay-cycle disputes, swap frequency and engagement pulse dips into a rules-based attrition watchlist with prompted stay-interviews — replacing exit surprises with early conversations.

items.title: Tamper-evident audit trail service
items.description: Hash-chained, append-only audit log for sensitive reads and writes (clinical notes, documents, payments, permission changes) with per-client access reports — the audit substrate GDPR/HIPAA-class markets and funders will demand.

items.title: One shell, role-shaped slices
items.description: The adaptive OWL workspace renders coordinator, nurse-manager and finance variants of the same center from access_roles — different KPI strips, docked actions and default filters, one codebase. Extends the proven BFSI adaptive-shell pattern to health.
items.builds_on: BFSI adaptive OWL shell pattern + access_roles

items.title: Watch-me-once macro maker
items.description: An admin performs any multi-step flow once in 'recording' mode; the system offers to save it as a named guided macro that other users replay step-by-step with their own data. Institutional knowledge becomes executable.

items.title: Dark ward mode after hours
items.description: After 21:00, always-on clinical dashboards auto-shift to a dimmed red-spectrum mono palette that preserves night vision and sleep hygiene near patient areas — circadian-respectful by token schedule.

items.title: Dictation Everywhere (Field-Level Voice Fill)
items.description: Any long-text field in the PWA and workspace forms gets a mic icon: speak, and the ASR+LLM writes a cleaned, field-appropriate entry (incident description, cancellation reason, family update). Vietnamese and English auto-detected; on-prem Whisper option for sovereignty.

items.title: Two-tier notifications: act-now vs digest
items.description: Web push and the PWA bell fire on everything, training staff to ignore them. Classify events: assignment offers and same-day changes push immediately; everything else batches into two daily digests. Per-FSO dedupe collapses repeated events into one updated notification.

items.title: Threshold-based pricing rule auto-approval
items.description: Every advanced_pricing rule change waits in the approval workflow regardless of impact. Auto-approve changes whose simulated revenue delta is under a configurable threshold; only high-impact rules route to the approver, with the plain-language rule explanation attached so approval is a 10-second read.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing approval workflow + plain-language rule explain

items.title: AI spam triage for inbound leads
items.description: Staff manually invoke action_mark_spam on junk leads one at a time. Run new leads through the existing multi-provider AI framework (local Ollama fine for sovereignty) to auto-quarantine obvious spam; humans review a weekly quarantine folder instead of policing the live pipeline.

items.title: One-tap doctor escalation with context
items.description: action_escalate_consultation / action_refer_telemedicine still require building the consultation booking manually afterwards. Make escalation a single action that creates the doctor consultation FSO with the lead/visit context, notes, and photos attached — no re-entry, no lost context.

items.title: Delta-only change notifications for staff
items.description: A single roster drag today can re-notify a nurse about their whole day, so real changes drown. Diff before/after on any schedule edit and send exactly one notification describing only what changed ('15:00 Mrs. Lan moved to 16:30'), superseding prior unread notices for the same FSO.
items.builds_on: Unified Staff Schedule edits + health_pwa notification pipeline

items.title: Offline Rural Care Mesh Sync
items.description: Nurse PWAs sync peer-to-peer over local Wi-Fi Direct/Bluetooth when two staff meet in a no-coverage area — handoff notes, schedule changes, and client updates hop device-to-device until any node reaches the internet. Extends the existing PouchDB replication with a signed CRDT layer. Makes the platform uniquely deployable in rural Mekong Delta, Laos, and Indonesian islands.

items.title: ASEAN Care Passport
items.description: A portable, client-owned care record: FHIR R4 bundle sealed with a verifiable QR that any provider (or hospital ER) in Vietnam, Singapore, or Malaysia can scan to read medications, allergies, care plan, and emergency contacts — online or offline. Positions the platform as the interoperability leader in a region with zero cross-border health records.

items.title: Schedule Scenario Sandbox
items.description: Draft-mode scheduling: clone next week's roster into a sandbox, drag freely, see cost/travel/continuity deltas versus live, then publish atomically with notifications. Coordinators experiment without fear — nothing hits staff phones until publish.

items.title: Family task requests
items.description: Coordinators or nurses assign lightweight tasks to families ('buy dressing supplies before Thursday', 'confirm medication list') that appear as portal checklists with reminders. Closes the loop on the informal asks that currently die in phone calls.

items.title: SMS gateway integration
items.description: Native SMS channel via Vietnamese brandname-SMS aggregators (eSMS/SpeedSMS) plus Twilio for international markets, with templates, delivery receipts and cost logging — the missing leg of the reminder cascade.

items.title: Kudos linked to client feedback
items.description: Positive CSAT comments and family compliments auto-generate recognition cards on the staff member's PWA feed and profile, with monthly awards fed by real client voice rather than manager memory.

items.title: Document management core
items.description: Versioned document store with types, retention policies, access rules by relation/role, full-text search and expiring share links — the single substrate behind the portal vault (FB-011), credential scans (FB-075) and contract files.

items.title: Odometer KPIs on live dashboards
items.description: AR total, visits-completed and revenue tiles roll digits like a mechanical odometer on live bus updates instead of blinking to a new number — change is felt, magnitude is preserved, attention is respected.

items.title: Buttons with press depth and draw-on ticks
items.description: PWA primary actions depress 2px on touch, and success states draw the checkmark as an animated SVG stroke (hf-wt-ico style) — sub-100ms haptic-grade feedback that makes gloved taps feel certain.
items.builds_on: health_pwa Quasar components + hf-wt-ico SVG set

items.title: One-motion-per-screen governance
items.description: Motion tokens enforce a hard rule: at most one animated element per viewport at a time, with an attention budget API components must request from. Delight with discipline — the anti-carnival.

items.title: Medication List & Reconciliation
items.description: Client medication profile (active/ceased, prescriber, indication, RxNorm coding) with reconciliation events at admission, hospital discharge and GP review; changes are diffed and countersigned. Feeds the existing OpenFDA interaction checker with a real structured list instead of ad-hoc lookups.

items.title: Granular Consent Management
items.description: Versioned consent records per client and per purpose (treatment, photography, data sharing, research, marketing) with capture method (signature, verbal-witnessed, guardian), expiry dates and withdrawal workflow. Guardian consents link through the existing kinship relation model.

items.title: Credential Compliance Watchtower
items.description: Organization-wide credential compliance dashboard: expiring registrations, missing police checks, overdue training by role and facility, with automated staff reminders (Zalo/push) at 60/30/7 days and manager escalation on lapse. Complements FA-045's booking-time hard stops with proactive prevention.

items.title: Interpreter request & language matching
items.description: Flag a booking as needing a language (Khmer, Mandarin, English); the system matches interpreter-capable staff from health.staff.skill language entries or books an external interpreter, and blocks assignment of unmatched staff.

items.title: Cards that physically travel the pipeline
items.description: When a booking advances stage, its card visibly slides along the kanban with token-defined easing and settles — state change becomes spatially legible across the room on a shared screen. All timings live in the theme motion tokens.
items.builds_on: theme token engine (motion tokens) + stage kanban

items.title: Pop-out chart widgets
items.description: Any ECharts visual pops out into an always-on-top mini window (Picture-in-Picture API) that keeps live-updating while you work elsewhere — the AR aging curve floats over your inbox all morning.

items.title: Lock-screen live counts for coordinators
items.description: PWA badge and rich push keep the coordinator's phone lock screen showing live critical counts (unassigned, running late) that update silently — the ops room in a pocket, no app open.

items.title: What-If Capacity Simulator in Chat
items.description: Managers ask counterfactuals — 'what if we add 3 nurses in Đà Nẵng?' or 'what if TET demand hits +40%?' — and the LLM orchestrates the demand forecast + assignment simulator to return projected utilization, unserved visits, and revenue deltas as a comparison card. Strategy decisions move from gut to grounded in one chat turn.
items.builds_on: AI-018 forecasting + AI staff assignment engine + biz_bi

items.title: Clinical Knowledge Graph over Care Records
items.description: A SNOMED-CT-anchored graph linking clients, conditions, interventions, medications, protocols, and outcomes mined from notes and structured data. Powers explainable reasoning: 'Clients with diabetes + Morse>45 who received protocol X healed 30% faster.' Runs graph queries locally; LLM natural-language interface rides the existing biz_bi pluggable-LLM layer.
items.builds_on: biz_bi LLM chart generation, health.clinical.protocol, future SNOMED coding layer

items.title: Home Environment Hazard Twin
items.description: During intake, the nurse walks the home capturing a guided photo/LiDAR scan; CV flags fall hazards (loose rugs, poor lighting, missing grab bars) onto a persistent floor-plan twin that links to the falls risk score and generates a remediation checklist families can act on. Occupational-therapy home assessments become data instead of paper.

items.title: Structured Progress Note Templates (SOAP/DAP)
items.description: Template-driven progress notes (SOAP, DAP, narrative-by-exception) layered onto health.clinical.note, with discipline-specific templates and mandatory-section validation. Notes become queryable sections instead of blobs, enabling trending and audit.

items.title: Problem List with ICD-10 Coding
items.description: Active/resolved problem list per client coded to ICD-10 (with Vietnamese MOH code set), linked to care plan goals and medications, and surfaced in referral and discharge documents. Prerequisite for insurer claims and FHIR Condition export.

items.title: Shift Offers & Swaps in the PWA
items.description: The shift marketplace lives natively in the nurse app: push-notified open shifts with pay and travel estimates, one-tap claim, swap requests with colleague picker, and status tracking. Adoption of FA-033/034 depends on this being effortless on a phone.

items.title: Biometric App Lock & Session Timeout
items.description: WebAuthn biometric unlock (FaceID/fingerprint) over the PWA with configurable idle auto-lock, so a phone left in a client's home never exposes clinical data. Unlock events are logged into the audit trail per device.

items.title: Insurance Policy Registry & Eligibility Checks
items.description: Client insurance policies (insurer, product, coverage class, validity) with pre-visit eligibility verification tasks and expiry alerts; policy data drives the payer rules engine and claim headers. Adapter-ready for future real-time eligibility APIs (VN BHYT, private insurers).

items.title: Quality Audit Program & Templates
items.description: Scheduled internal audits (documentation audits, medication audits, home-safety spot checks) built on the forms engine with sampling rules, scoring, findings, and CAPA actions feeding the same corrective-action pipeline as incidents. Maps to VN MOH quality criteria and AU Aged Care Quality Standards.

items.title: Restrictive Practices Register
items.description: Register of restrictive practices (chemical, physical, environmental) per disability/aged-care client with authorization evidence, usage event logging from visits, mandatory review dates, and jurisdiction reporting extracts (e.g. NDIS monthly RP reporting). A hard regulatory requirement for the Australian expansion.

items.title: Complaints & Feedback Management
items.description: Complaint lifecycle (intake from any channel including Zalo → acknowledge → investigate → resolve → close-the-loop with the complainant) with statutory timers, severity routing, and trend analytics tied to clients, staff and services. Regulator-ready extracts for VN MOH and AU Aged Care complaints reporting.

items.title: Installment & payment-plan view
items.description: Portal surface for agreed payment plans on large care packages: schedule, paid/due status, next auto-reminder date — synced with AR data from health_invoicing. Reduces AR aging without awkward collection calls.

items.title: Quote-to-care conversion funnel
items.description: End-to-end funnel instrumentation from enquiry → quote sent → quote verified (PWA) → first visit → package purchase, as a biz_bi gold dataset with drop-off analysis by channel, province and service line.
items.builds_on: biz_bi semantic layer + PWA quote verification

items.title: Cross-facility benchmarking
items.description: Compare facilities and provinces on the quality KPI pack and margin metrics with league tables, small-multiple sparklines and variance-to-network-median callouts — internal competition that lifts every site.

items.title: Referral source ROI attribution
items.description: Full-journey attribution from channel/partner/event through to lifetime revenue and margin, answering 'which hospital partnership actually pays' with data instead of anecdote.

items.title: Staff productivity & visit efficiency analytics
items.description: Per-staff views of visits/day, on-time %, documentation lag, travel-to-care time ratio and revenue contribution — designed as coaching inputs with fairness context (province density), not surveillance leaderboards.

items.title: Structured onboarding journeys (30/60/90)
items.description: Role-templated onboarding checklists — documents, training modules, shadow visits, competency sign-offs — with progress tracked in the PWA and gates that unlock solo-visit eligibility only when the journey completes.

items.title: Training & CPD tracker
items.description: Track continuing-education requirements per role and jurisdiction with hour targets, course records and certificates linked to credentials — and auto-nominate staff for courses that clear skill gaps identified in FB-078.

items.title: Feature flags & staged rollout
items.description: Runtime flags scoping new features to facilities, roles or percentage cohorts with kill switches — so portal, PWA and scheduling changes ship dark and roll out gradually instead of big-bang upgrades on a live care operation.

items.title: Date math and calculator inline in palette
items.description: Type 'next tue +3d' or '450000*1.08' anywhere a date or amount is expected and the palette resolves it live, with Vietnamese natural forms ('thứ ba tuần sau'). Removes the calendar-widget hunt from every reschedule.

items.title: Theme Studio speaks your language
items.description: In Theme Studio, type 'denser tables, teal brand, softer corners' and the LLM emits a token diff (tokens.css) with instant live preview and revert. Brand-tuning an entire deployment becomes a conversation.

items.title: Time-travel scrubber for the ops day
items.description: Drag a scrubber under the dispatch board to replay the day: watch bookings assign, start and complete as an animation, and stop at the moment things went wrong. Post-mortems become 30-second replays.

items.title: Just-in-time field whispers
items.description: Hovering (or long-pressing on touch) any field label for 500ms reveals a one-line micro-explanation sourced from the health_field_requirements definitions — documentation lives at the pixel where the question arises.

items.title: Shake to report an issue
items.description: Shaking the phone captures a screenshot, device state, sync queue depth and route context into a prefilled issue report — field bugs arrive reproducible instead of as 'app không chạy' texts.

items.title: Thirty-second cinematic day recap
items.description: At close of day, an auto-generated 30-second motion piece plays on the wall: visits completed sweeping across the province map, kilometers ridden, revenue rolled, best moment highlighted — data storytelling that makes the team feel the day.
items.builds_on: biz_bi datasets + ECharts animation + catchment map

items.title: Commission auto-computed at close
items.description: FSO commission tracking fields exist but statements are assembled manually each month. Compute commission at action_close_fso from the rule set, accumulate into an auto-generated monthly statement per staff/referrer, and route only out-of-band amounts for approval.
items.builds_on: health_fieldservice commission tracking + FSO close transition

items.title: Controlled Drug Register & Double Signature
items.description: Digital controlled-substance register with running balance per client/site, mandatory second-person e-signature on administration and discrepancy alerts on count mismatch. Hash-chained entries make the register tamper-evident for regulators.

items.title: Demand Forecast vs Roster Gap Analysis
items.description: Rolling forecast of visit demand (from bookings, recurring series and referral pipeline) laid against rostered supply, producing hiring and roster-adjustment signals weeks ahead. Delivered as a biz_bi gold dataset so it inherits the semantic layer and dashboards.

items.title: Self-service reschedule & cancel
items.description: Clients move or cancel visits inside policy windows enforced by Blockly rules (notice period, fee triggers, package impact), with the change flowing through the existing cancellation workflow. Coordinators only see exceptions.
items.builds_on: advanced_pricing Blockly rules + FSO cancellation workflow

items.title: Photo & media consent controls
items.description: Families toggle exactly what media may be captured and who may view it (wound photos clinical-only, general photos family-visible), enforced at PWA capture time and portal render time.

items.title: Multi-tenant operations console
items.description: Fleet view across tenant databases: version/module drift, cron health, PWA sync backlog, error rates and usage metrics, with bulk upgrade orchestration — the operational backbone for selling health19 to other providers.

items.title: Palette bulk ops on list selections
items.description: Select rows in any list, hit Cmd+K, and run 'assign to…', 'send Zalo reminder', 'mark collected' across the selection with a live preview count and one undo. Stripe-dashboard-grade batch ergonomics for care ops.

items.title: Undo-first, confirmation-free design
items.description: Replace every confirmation dialog with immediate soft execution plus a 10-second undo toast (cancel booking, delete note, send reminder) — destructive-action anxiety disappears and flows accelerate measurably.

items.title: Clinic lobby 'now serving' ambient screen
items.description: A Theme-Studio-branded lobby display showing queue position by discreet initials, current room status and gentle wayfinding — the clinic's calmest employee, configured not coded per facility.

items.title: Pressure Injury Risk Prediction
items.description: Combines mobility scores, continence flags, nutrition mentions, and visit-frequency data into a Braden-style risk score computed automatically rather than form-filled, prompting wound-prevention protocol activation (health.clinical.protocol) when threshold crossed. Feeds the wound CV pipeline (AI-045) once lesions exist.

items.title: AI Coding Assistant for Services & Diagnoses
items.description: When SNOMED/ICD-10 coding lands (interop roadmap), an LLM suggests codes from the visit note and booked services with confidence scores and 'why' snippets; coder accepts or overrides, and overrides fine-tune the prompt exemplars. Local-model capable for markets where notes cannot leave the server.

items.title: Drag-swap two nurses' days on roster
items.description: Swapping two staff currently means editing each assignment on both sides. On the roster/timeline board, dragging one nurse's day onto another's swaps all their assignments for that day in one gesture, with skill/availability validation via the existing validate_drop API before commit.
items.builds_on: Unified Staff Schedule validate_drop API + health_roster board

items.title: Rules-based lead scoring
items.description: Score enquiries on channel, service type, urgency, catchment coverage and payer signals using transparent Blockly rules (no black-box AI), so coordinators call the highest-yield leads first.

items.title: Personal command ranking and recents
items.description: The palette learns each user's verbs: a finance user sees 'record payment' first, a coordinator sees 'assign nurse'. Frecency ranking stored per user, synced across devices — zero configuration.

items.title: Map hover client card
items.description: Hovering any client pin surfaces a mini card: photo, last visit, next booking, outstanding balance, primary caregiver — with jump actions. The map becomes a browsable client directory, not just dots.

items.title: Time-limited guest access links
items.description: Primary contacts issue expiring, scope-limited portal links (e.g., visiting relative sees this week's schedule only; hospital doctor sees the care summary for 72 hours). Auditable, revocable, no account creation needed.

items.title: Secure in-app messaging
items.description: Threaded, role-scoped messaging between families, coordinators and the care team inside portal and PWA — encrypted at rest, auditable, and attached to the client record. The private-data channel Zalo chat can never be.

items.title: Relationship network that plays through time
items.description: Add a time slider to the existing D3 kinship graph: watch payer, caregiver and referrer links appear as the relationship deepened, and spot when a referrer node went quiet. Network analysis becomes a story.

items.title: Spring physics on roster drags
items.description: Roster cards tilt subtly with drag velocity and settle with a critically-damped spring on drop — the board feels like matter, not markup. Figma-grade direct manipulation on the planning surface.

items.title: Series-Level Edits with Propagation
items.description: Google-Calendar-grade series editing: change time, staff or services for 'this visit', 'this and future', or 'all', with a diff preview of affected bookings and invoices before commit. Guardrails prevent edits from breaking already-verified or invoiced visits.

items.title: Fatigue & Break Compliance Rules in Rostering
items.description: Configurable work-rule engine (max consecutive hours, minimum rest between shifts, weekly caps, night-shift limits) validated live during scheduling and swaps, with jurisdiction presets for VN labor law and AU awards. Violations show inline on the timeline before they become payroll disputes.

items.title: Service Agreements with Funded Line Items
items.description: Digital service agreements binding client, payer, funded services, rates, schedule of supports and review dates, e-signed via the signature capture flow; delivery outside an active agreement is flagged before it becomes unbillable work. Agreements version cleanly on plan changes.

items.title: Remittance Reconciliation & Shortfall Workflow
items.description: Import payer remittance files, auto-match against submitted claims, and route shortfalls into a rework queue with reason codes (price variance, rejected line, partial payment) and resubmission tracking. AR truth comes from reconciliation, not hope.

items.title: Collections & Promise-to-Pay Tracking
items.description: Structured collections workflow on aged receivables: dunning sequences (Zalo/SMS/email/VoIP call tasks), promise-to-pay records with broken-promise escalation, hardship plans, and write-off approval chains. Every touch is logged against the AR dashboard's aging buckets.

items.title: Data Subject Rights Console (GDPR/PDPD)
items.description: Self-serve console for privacy officers handling access/export/rectification/erasure requests under GDPR and Vietnam PDPD Decree 13: request intake, identity verification, scoped machine-readable export, anonymization with clinical-retention carve-outs, and statutory-deadline tracking.

items.title: Document vault with sharing
items.description: Secure area for care agreements, assessments, invoices and medical documents with per-relation visibility, download audit trail, and expiring share links. The client-side face of the platform DMS (FB-102).

items.title: WhatsApp Business channel
items.description: WhatsApp Business API as a peer channel to Zalo — same template, reminder and chat-hub abstractions — unlocking Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Australia where Zalo has no footprint.

items.title: Credential document verification workflow
items.description: Staff upload credential scans via PWA; a verification queue lets HR approve with checker identity, date and document hash recorded — audit-ready evidence for funder and government inspections.

items.title: Agency & contractor staff pool
items.description: Manage external agency workers as a distinct pool with agency rate cards, compliance gating (credentials verified before any assignment), separate cost accounting and agency performance scorecards — surge capacity without compliance leaks.

items.title: Webhooks & event bus
items.description: Signed, retried webhook subscriptions on domain events (visit.completed, invoice.paid, credential.expiring) with delivery logs and replay — letting partners and internal automations react in real time without polling.

items.title: Two-note earcons for the ops room
items.description: Optional distinct two-note audio motifs for exactly two events — urgent-unassigned and missed check-in — spatially subtle, volume-capped, per-facility configurable. Ears watch the wall so eyes don't have to.

items.title: Nightly auto-merge of duplicate leads
items.description: action_merge_similar_leads exists but only fires when a human remembers. A nightly job auto-merges leads with identical normalized phone/email (keeping full chatter history), and queues fuzzy name+province matches for one-click human confirmation.

items.title: Address lives once, inherits everywhere
items.description: Visit addresses get re-keyed per booking and patched via action_edit_patient_address on the FSO. Make the address canonical on res.partner with smart inheritance into every FSO and a per-visit override flag; editing on any FSO offers 'update client record too' so the fix propagates forward.

items.title: Calendar feed (ICS) for visit schedules
items.description: Per-client tokenized ICS URL so upcoming visits appear in Google/Apple calendars of every family member, always current as bookings change. Near-zero build cost, daily perceived value.

items.title: Portal in vi/en with per-relation language
items.description: Each family member gets the portal, digests and reminders in their own language preference (grandchild in English, parent in Vietnamese), reusing the platform's existing i18n plumbing. Table stakes for the diaspora-funded care segment.

items.title: Lost-reason capture & win-back
items.description: Mandatory structured lost reasons (price, no capacity, competitor, timing) on dead enquiries, feeding a win-back queue that re-approaches 'timing' and 'no capacity' losses when circumstances change.

items.title: Acting on it dismisses the notification
items.description: Nurses manually dismiss each bell item (api_dismiss_notification) even after handling the underlying FSO. Auto-dismiss all notifications tied to an FSO the moment the user acts on it (accepts, checks in, completes), syncing dismissal across web and PWA — the bell only ever shows undone work.

items.title: Stale draft auto-expiry with lead revival
items.description: Draft FSOs abandoned mid-intake linger and pollute every pipeline view until someone sweeps them. Auto-cancel drafts untouched for N days, reactivate the originating lead with a 'booking abandoned' reason, and schedule one follow-up activity — the pipeline self-cleans.
items.builds_on: health_fieldservice FSO draft state + health_crm lead reason codes

items.title: NFC Tag Check-In at Client Home
items.description: Optional NFC tags placed in client homes provide GPS-independent, offline-capable presence proof: tap-to-check-in records the tag ID cryptographically even in high-rise buildings where GPS fails. Complements geofencing as a second EVV evidence factor.

items.title: Telehealth waiting room + device check
items.description: Pre-visit lobby that tests camera/mic/bandwidth, shows queue position, and pings the practitioner via the existing staff notification bell when the client arrives. Removes the 5-minute 'can you hear me' tax on every video visit.

items.title: Preceptor/buddy pairing
items.description: Match new hires with experienced preceptors by skill overlap, province and shift pattern; schedule shadow visits automatically into both rosters and capture structured preceptor feedback that feeds the onboarding gates (FB-076).

items.title: Drag visits between packages
items.description: In the Finance Center, drag a delivered visit line from one prepaid package to another to reallocate entitlements, with live burn-down recalculation and an audit log entry. Package corrections without a support ticket.

items.title: Payer Batch Invoicing & Statements
items.description: Monthly/weekly batch invoice runs per payer with consolidated statements, per-client sub-summaries and attached verification evidence bundles, generated and dispatched (email/portal upload) in one action. Extends health_invoicing from per-visit invoices to institutional billing.

items.title: HIPAA Readiness Pack
items.description: Operational controls bundle for regulated-market entry: periodic user-access reviews with attestation, minimum-necessary role templates, security-risk-assessment checklist, breach register with notification-clock tracking, and BAA document management. Sold as the switch that opens US/SG enterprise deals.

items.title: SMART-on-FHIR App Launch
items.description: SMART App Launch support so vetted third-party clinical apps (medication references, specialist calculators, telehealth tools) launch in-context with the current client and scoped tokens — no data re-entry, no credential sharing. Turns the platform into an extensible clinical operating system rather than a closed app.

items.title: Payer mix & AR intelligence
items.description: Dashboards slicing revenue and AR aging by payer type (private, family-split, corporate, funder), with collection-risk flags and DSO trends per segment — extending the AR dashboard from list to insight.

items.title: Clinical supervision scheduler
items.description: Plan and record mandatory supervision sessions (field observation, case review) per role cadence, with outcomes writing evidence into the competency matrix and overdue-supervision flags on the compliance dashboard.

items.title: Payroll export bridge
items.description: Approved timecards, OT, travel reimbursements (FB-080) and visit bonuses exported in VN payroll/MISA-compatible formats on a period close, extending the existing MISA sync fields from billing into workforce cost flow.

items.title: Restrained completion moments
items.description: Completing a full care package triggers one crafted moment — a check sweep and a two-note chime, no confetti — consistent with flat mono design language. Celebration that respects a clinical product's dignity.

items.title: Continence & Bowel Monitoring
items.description: Bristol-scale bowel charts and continence records with configurable no-movement alert windows (e.g. flag after 3 days) feeding directly into nurse review tasks. Simple, high-frequency documentation that must be two-tap fast on the PWA.

items.title: Policy Library with Read-and-Acknowledge
items.description: Versioned policy/procedure library with role-targeted distribution, mobile read-and-acknowledge tracking, quiz-check options, and re-acknowledgement on new versions; acknowledgement status is audit-exportable per accreditation cycle. Staff read policies where they work — on the PWA.

items.title: Nutrition & Hydration Charts
items.description: Food and fluid intake charting with per-client daily targets, deficit alerts by mid-afternoon, and weight-trend correlation. Essential for aged-care accreditation and a frequent family complaint area competitors handle poorly.

items.title: MDT Case Conference Records
