items.description: Multi-disciplinary case conference object: attendees, client goals reviewed, decisions, and actions that spawn tasks and care plan revisions with full traceability. Conference outcomes link to the D3 relationship graph so family participants are captured too.

items.title: FHIR Bulk Data Export
items.description: FHIR Bulk $export (flat NDJSON) for whole-population or cohort extracts, powering payer reporting, research datasets, migrations and external analytics without bespoke ETL projects. Exports respect consent gating and are fully audit-logged.

items.title: Community outreach & event tracker
items.description: Plan health-talk events at hospitals, temples and corporates; generate per-event QR codes that open a lead form tagged to the event, so every seminar's pipeline contribution is measurable.

items.title: Template library with ZNS approval tracking
items.description: One managed catalogue of message templates across channels, tracking Zalo's ZNS template approval lifecycle (draft → submitted → approved/rejected) and variable schemas, so campaigns never fail on an unapproved template.

items.title: Quiet hours & channel preferences
items.description: Per-contact contact-window and channel-priority settings (no SMS after 20:00; Zalo first; never call grandma's number) enforced platform-wide by the send pipeline, not per-feature.

items.title: Rules-based Zalo FAQ bot
items.description: Deterministic keyword/menu bot in the Zalo chat hub answering the top-20 questions (prices, hours, service areas, how to book) with instant handoff to a human coordinator — deflecting ~40% of inbound chat volume without LLM risk.

items.title: Staff wellness pulse
items.description: Optional fortnightly 3-question mood/workload pulse in the PWA (anonymous at team level, 20 seconds), trended alongside fatigue signals to give managers a leading indicator on team health.

items.title: Demo & sandbox data factory
items.description: One-command generation of a realistic anonymised tenant — clients, kinship graphs, bookings, packages, BI history — for sales demos, partner sandboxes and safe UAT, replacing hand-built demo clients like the 861-864 set.

items.title: Household dedupe via relation graph
items.description: Detect duplicate contacts and same-household records using phone/Zalo ID overlap plus the D3 relationship network, with a guided merge that preserves kinship links, bookings and billing history.

items.title: Extension marketplace framework
items.description: A curated registry where vetted add-on modules (country adapters, payer connectors, niche care verticals) are discovered, licensed and installed per tenant with declared permission scopes — the path from product to platform ecosystem.

items.title: Delivery analytics & comms audit log
items.description: Every outbound message logged with channel, template, delivery status, cost and read state; biz_bi dashboards expose failure hotspots (dead numbers, blocked Zalo) and a compliance-grade audit trail per client.

items.title: Comms cost dashboard
items.description: Per-channel unit costs (ZNS fee, SMS fee, call minutes) rolled up by campaign, department and client segment in biz_bi — making the cascade's fallback ordering a data-driven cost decision.

items.title: Offboarding & access revocation checklist
items.description: Exit workflow bundling equipment return (FB-091), final timecard close, exit interview capture and same-day revocation of PWA/portal/Zalo-hub access via access_roles — no ghost accounts holding patient data.

items.title: Imaging Reports & DICOM Link-Out
items.description: Ingest imaging reports as FHIR DiagnosticReport with secure link-out to the source PACS/DICOM viewer (no local PACS build), attaching studies to the client chart and referral packets. Positions the platform as imaging-aware for post-acute and wound-care workflows without DICOM storage cost.

items.title: SSO & SCIM provisioning
items.description: SAML/OIDC single sign-on with SCIM user lifecycle sync from corporate IdPs (Google, Microsoft Entra) — mandatory checkbox for B2B contracts (FB-031) and enterprise/government tenants, wired into access_roles mapping.

items.title: Self-service backup & tenant export
items.description: Tenant admins schedule encrypted backups and run full data exports (structured JSON/CSV plus documents) on demand — data-portability assurance that de-risks the buying decision for providers switching platforms.

items.title: Retention & Archival Policies per Record Class
items.description: Declarative retention schedules per record class (clinical notes 10y, financial 7y, CCTV/photos configurable) with automated archival to cold storage, legal-hold override, and certified-destruction logs. Jurisdiction presets handle VN, SG and AU retention law differences per company.

items.title: Uniform & equipment issue tracking
items.description: Register of issued kit (uniforms, BP monitors, phones, nurse bags) per staff member with condition, return-on-exit checklists and replacement schedules — small module, real shrinkage savings at scale.
